notes:
smelt 2 promethium ores into two promethium bars and smith a promethium full helm.

One's Smithing level can be boosted from level 88 with an artisan's potion or from level 84 with a strong artisan's potion if necessary. Promethium ores cost 102,000 rusty coins each if bought from the smuggler. Mining them requires a Mining level of 90.
tan a zombie cowhide in New Varrock.

catch a tuna without a harpoon.

There are plenty of tuna catching spots on the docks around the Fremennik Province. However it is not required to catch the tuna in Rellekka, players can use any harpoon spot, for example the one in Catherby.

use a waka canoe to travel to the Wilderness.

The hatchet may be on the tool belt.
climb the ladder outside of the bank (on its northern wall), located on the Lumbridge Castle roof.
raise the flag on the roof of the bank on the roof of Lumbridge Castle.
mine some copper ore in the Lumbridge south-east mine in the south-east of the Lumbridge Swamp.
pray at the Lumbridge Church's altar with the Mystic Might prayer enabled.
get a strength potion made by the Apothecary in Varrock which requires 5 coins, a limpwurt root, and red spiders' eggs.
enter the Champions' Guild.

take the Dagon'hai's shortcut, Tunnel of Chaos, to the chaos altar. To access the chaos altar, the player will need either a chaos talisman, chaos tiara, omni talisman, omni-tiara, or wicked hood with a chaos talisman added to it.

The entrance to the Tunnel of Chaos is the Saradomin statue west of the earth altar. There are benches next to it. Players may require excavating it prior to entering.

catch six rats using a pet cat whilst wielding a rat pole.

These do not need to be caught in the same house as in the quest - Varrock Sewers is fine.

leave the deadly red spider area in the Varrock sewers after picking up red spiders' eggs. This achievement can be completed by teleporting out. While the sign of the porter effect is active, the eggs will be teleported to the bank directly, preventing the player from completing this achievement.

perform the four emotes from the Stronghold of Security.

Players must first complete the Stronghold of Security. The four emotes are Idea, Stomp, Flap, and Slap Head.

select a colour for a new kitten, costing 100 coins.

Players must wear a ring of charos (a) and charm Gertrude so that they may select the colour of their new kitten. Gertrude will not sell a kitten to the player if they already have a kitten or cat with them or in the bank. However, she does not check the menagerie of the player-owned house.

The act of retrieving a new kitten will reset the current rat kill counter, which may interfere with obtaining the Faster, Pussycat! Kill! Kill! achievement.
use the shortcut under the wall, north-west of the Grand Exchange and east of the bridge over the River Lum just south of the Wilderness wall.
enter the dungeon featured in A Soul's Bane rift.
teleport to the Varrock Dig Site using a Dig Site pendant or Ali's pendant from the The Temple at Senntisten.
create an earth tiara at the earth altar while carrying an earth talisman and a tiara in the backpack.
pickpocket a guard in the Varrock Palace's courtyard.
cast the Varrock Teleport spell which is found the normal spellbook which requires the usage of 3 air, 1 fire, and 1 law rune.
get a Slayer assignment from Vannaka who is found in the ruins south of the Edgeville bank.
make a maple plank on the sawmill in Fort Forinthry.
pick a white tree fruit from the white tree in Varrock Palace's garden.

use the hot-air balloon to travel from Varrock to somewhere else.

Players must unlock the ability to travel from Varrock by voyaging from Entrana to Varrock first, which requires 30 charges. Subsequent voyages only cost 3 charges. The initial travel will not count.

get a cat training medal from Gertrude. This requires getting a pet cat (of any type) to catch 100 rats.

The player's character will say when their cat catches 100 rats. Upon the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, and 100th rat caught, a short one-sided dialogue will take place, wherein the player congratulates their cat on the milestone. After the 100th catch, talking to Gertrude will give the medal.

Catching rats with a kitten is significantly slower than with a grown cat, and grown cats will lose their catch count when becoming overgrown. Wily cats have the highest catch rate and are thus highly recommended for this achievement, although these require the cat to age past its regular adult stage and need full completion of the Rat Catchers quest.

Note that obtaining a new kitten will reset the current rat kill counter, so ensure to claim the medal prior to retrieving a new kitten.

teleport to the fairy ring with code which is located west of Varrock.

Dramen staff or Lunar staff are required if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift is not completed yet.
open Oziach's Armour shop.

access Thessalia's Makeovers through Thessalia.

The achievement won't unlock if the player chooses the default option "Talk-to" on Thessalia. They have to choose another option "Change-clothes" on her.
access the Rune Essence mine through Aubury.
make a plank on the sawmill in Fort Forinthry.
mine iron ore at the south-west Varrock mining site.
enter the second level of the Stronghold of Security.

find the highest point in Varrock.

The highest point of Varrock is the Varrock Palace guard tower. This is north-west of the chapel, accessed from the bottom floor by the staircase west of the library. Climbing to the highest point of the Varrock Saradominist church will also count as the highest point.
jump over the fence, south of Varrock. The fence is an agility shortcut just north of the hops patch in Lumbridge.
chop down a dead tree next to Varrock's south east wall and the Varrock south-east mine.
buy a copy of the Varrock Herald newspaper.

give bones to a stray dog.

A stray dog can be found south of Varrock's east bank near Aubury's Rune Shop.

If 2012 Christmas event was completed, feed the pet stray dog which was rewarded from the event:
* Patch, a mongrel found in Varrock
* Sir Chen Rescoo, a Labrador found in Falador
* Little 'Elper, a Dalmatian found in Al Kharid
* Oddie, a Doberman found in Draynor Village
make a bowl, which requires a piece of soft clay, on the pottery wheel then fire it in the pottery oven, all in Barbarian Village.
enter Edgeville Dungeon using the entrance to the south of Edgeville.
move the player-owned house portal to a different location by talking to the Varrock estate agent which costs 5,000 coins. The house is not lost in the process.

speak to curator Haig Halen, who is found on the of the Varrock Museum, after obtaining at least 50 kudos.

In order to get 50 kudos, players can use any of the five following methods:
* By cleaning finds (50 kudos)
* By answering a natural history quiz about museum exhibits given by Orlando Smith (or Mark Brodie, who is found at the same location, if The World Wakes is already completed) in the basement (28 kudos)
* By relating details of certain completed quests to Historian Minas (currently 95 kudos)
* By completing the Statue of Dahmaroc for the first time (10 kudos)
* By completing dragonkin related quests and tasks and talking to Mr Mordaut (15 kudos)

A total of 198 kudos can be earned in the Museum.
enter the earth altar using an earth tiara, earth talisman, or a wicked hood with an earth talisman fed to it.
speak with Horacio the Duke of Lumbridge, who is located on the of Lumbridge Castle.
talk to the Lumbridge Sage who can be found to the east of Lumbridge Castle.
speak with the Doomsayer about the Warning System.
make some soft clay by using clay on a container of water, e.g. bucket of water, or a water source.
make an unfired pot on any potter's wheel, requiring one soft clay.
fire an unfired pot in a pottery oven.

find out about the Rules of Conduct from the town crier in Draynor Village.
climb to the top of the Wizards' Tower.

look through Father Aereck's selection of gravestones.

play the church organ in the Lumbridge Church.

visit Fred the Farmer's chicken and sheep farm located north of Lumbridge, west of the River Lum.
grind some flour in the Mill Lane Mill, north-west of Lumbridge.
mine some iron ore from the Lumbridge south-west mine.
catch a raw pike by bait fishing in the River Lum to the east of Lumbridge Castle.

search the shed in Lumbridge Swamp, with or without travelling to Zanaris by doing so.
light a fire using standard logs in Lumbridge Swamp.
cook some raw rat meat on a fire in Lumbridge Swamp. Make a fire within the boundaries of the swamp and use the meat on the fire; the achievement is completed even if the meat is burnt.
craft a water rune at the water altar.
get a replacement ghostspeak amulet from Father Urhney.
choose the "Taunt" option on the lesser demon on the of the Wizards' Tower.
be teleported by Archmage Sedridor to the Rune Essence mine. Sedridor can be found sitting at his desk located on the southern side of the of the Wizards' Tower.
access the bank in Draynor Village.

discover what the Wise Old Man is watching through his telescope.

cast the Fire Blast spell at one of the goblins or giant spiders in the Lumbridge area (including the Lumbridge Catacombs and Lumbridge Swamp). Players must successfully hit the target to be awarded the achievement.
burn yew logs on the of the Lumbridge Castle gatehouse.

buy any stat-boosting drink from a waitress in the Rising Sun tavern in western Falador.

buy a black chainbody from Wayne's Chains - Chainmail Specialist and equip it.

fill a bucket with water from the water pump found north of Falador west bank.

A bucket can be bought from the nearby general store.

cast an elemental spell on an elemental wizard in order to heal him. Spells from the Ancient Magicks spellbook also work.

The wizards can be found north-west of Port Sarim, alongside Malignius Mortifer. Whenever they are attacked by a spell of their corresponding element, they are healed instead of damaged, so attacking the air wizard with an air spell will heal him.

kill a duck in Falador Park.
kill a highwayman found south of Falador.

make a mind tiara.

A mind tiara can be made by using a mind talisman on the Mind altar, found in the north-east corner of Goblin Village, with a blank tiara in the inventory.
talk to Party Pete in Party Room.
recharge their prayer points at the altar found south-west of Port Sarim.

travel to Entrana via boat.

As Entrana is considered a holy place, it is forbidden to take any combat equipment. The monks who transport the player will check and list any items in their inventory or equipped which are forbidden. There is a bank deposit box by the monks. For a more detailed list of permitted and forbidden items, see list of permitted and forbidden items on Entrana.

pass through the shortcut leading under Falador's south wall.

kill a Black Knight in order to increase their rank with the White Knights.

Any black knight found throughout Gielinor will work for this, not just those in Asgarnia.

kill an ice giant within the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.

As ice giants are level 47, it is advised to take combat gear. As they are weak to fire spells, it is advised to bring magic gear.

Only one allotment patch needs to have sweetcorn growing in it. The order in which the scarecrow and sweetcorn are placed does not matter, as the achievement will be completed once both patches are filled.

Goblin Salute will also work for this.

climb to the top of the Dark Wizards' Tower west of Falador while wearing full proselyte armour.

change their family crest to the Saradominist symbol at Sir Renitee, located on the east end of the of the White Knights' Castle.

Sir Renitee will give players a money crest voucher if they had the money crest prior to changing the symbol for the task, which reduces the cost of switching the crest back.

craft 140 mind runes simultaneously without using runecrafting pouches, familiars. Players cannot bring essence that is stored in any of the ethereal outfits while completing this achievement but the outfit can be worn while doing this achievement.

An inventory of 28 pure essence or rune essence requires a multiplier of 5 to get to 140 mind runes.

kill a skeletal Wyvern in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.

Skeletal wyverns have a breath attack which can be defended against by using any elemental workshop shield or dragonfire shield. The altar is found on the . If the ability to swap back to prayers at any altar has been disabled, it must be reactivated at the Zarosian altar in Senntisten Temple or the elven grimoire in the Cadarn district of Prifddinas.

have Elsie tell a story by giving her a cup of tea. Elsie can be found on the of the Varrock Saradominist church in north-east Varrock, and a cup of tea can be bought or stolen from the tea stall in south-east Varrock.

bake a chocolate cake from scratch in the Lumbridge Castle's kitchen. For members, all ingredients can be purchased from the Culinaromancer's Chest, but the cake itself must be made in the kitchen.

To bake a chocolate cake:
* Mix an egg, a bucket of milk and a pot of flour in a cake tin to create an uncooked cake.
* Bake the uncooked cake on the cooking range.
* Add a chocolate bar to the cake to create a chocolate cake (make sure to choose the "Use" option, as the default option is "Eat").

have Beefy Bill bank an item for them.

Beefy Bill will transport pot of flour, cowhides, or raw beef to the bank, charging a 10% commission (rounded up), or for free if charmed with an activated ring of charos. To access this feature, players must either directly talk to Beefy Bill or use the respective items on him; there is no Bank option. Beefy Bill can be found on the north side of Lumbridge, just north-east of the Mill Lane Mill.

catch a trout in the River Lum to the east of Barbarian Village which requires feathers or having at least the tier 3 featherless fly fishing prawn perk unlocked in the aquarium in player-owned house.

The cobwebbed corridor is past the spiderweb leading to the red spiders in the Varrock Sewers, after walking past the zombies and ghosts.

If the player takes the long route, there is no need to have protection against the NPCs. However if the player takes the short route, a high combat level is strongly recommended.
sell some rubium to Ezekial Lovecraft, who is the owner of the fishing shop in the town of Witchaven.

catch a fish at the Fishing Platform using either a net or rod.

recharge a combat bracelet or a skills necklace at the totem pole inside the Legends' Guild. A quick way to get to the Guild is by going to fairy ring .

kill a shadow warrior in the Legends' Guild basement. The shadow warriors do not appear as yellow dots on the minimap.
enter the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. Boosts can be used to enter the guild.
use the western portal located on the top floor of the Wizards' Guild to teleport to the Sorcerer's Tower.

be on the winning side in a game of Castle Wars. A draw will not count. This achievement does not require everyone in the match to be present at the end. It can be completed by having four players join a match, having the player who needs the achievement score, and then the other three players can simply leave via the exit portals. The player wanting the achievement MUST stay until the end of the match, however.

It is possible to complete this achievement with only one other player by doing the following steps:

# Go to the Castle Wars lobby with the other player.
# One player must enter the Zamorak portal and the other player must enter the Saradomin portal.
# Both players logout/go to lobby and re-enter the same world that you were in previously.
# Enter the same portals again. A 3 minute countdown should appear if successful.

Afterwards, get 1 point and wait till you win. The other player can leave by waiting a few minutes where they spawned.

It is also possible to exit a match halfway through if your team is losing (and you know that the other team is going to win.) Then enter the winning teams portal to re-join the match on the winning side and get the achievement. Please note however that you can only re-join if someone else leaves the match from the team you are trying to join, so there is a chance that if you leave you might not be able to re-join.

Boosts may be used for the Thieving requirement.

kill a frogeel in the Tower of Life.

Use a raw cave eel and giant frog legs on the western altar (be careful not to eat the giant frog legs).
wield the Karamjan monkey greegree while in the Ardougne Zoo and speak to one of the monkey minders to be put in the monkey cage.

kill the player grown wild jade vine after the Back to my Roots quest.

Plant a jade vine seed and, optionally, pay Horacio 10 wildblood hops (8 with the master farmer outfit) to protect it. Return to the plant once it is fully grown, and check its health. Do not 'clear' the patch. Instead, the jade vine must be left alone after checking it, for about 3 hours more. After that, it turns wild and becomes a level 72 wild jade vine (which should look like this), which players can kill for 2,500 Slayer experience and 650 Woodcutting experience. Remember to take decent melee weapons (rune or above recommended).

Optionally, a Supreme growth potion (leafy) can be used to instantly grow the wild jade vine. You must still wait several hours for it to turn wild, however.

use the Air Guitar emote near the musician south-east of the Ardougne Monastery, south of Ardougne.

Quick ways to unlock new music tracks to reach the requirement include exploration, quests, and Dungeoneering.
cast the Watchtower Teleport spell which requires 2 law runes and 2 earth runes. Teleport tablets do not work.

cross the monkeybars from either side in the Yanille Agility dungeon.

The entrance north of Yanille requires a slash weapon to access, and it requires level 57 Agility to cross from northern side. The entrance in southern Yanille requires level 82 Thieving and a lockpick to access. Players do not need to be successful at crossing the monkey bars; a failed attempt will also complete the achievement.

catch a red salamander from the Hunter area outside of Ourania Runecrafting Altar.

Requires a small fishing net (tool belt does not work) and a rope to set up traps. 

If As a First Resort is completed, players will be able to boost their Hunter skill by 7 levels by using the mud bath in Oo'glog. 

It can be feasibly completed by boosting with at least 54 Hunter if the player has the Ourania Teleport spell. Having 54 Hunter allows the player sufficient time for a few attempts at the trap with the mud bath level boost before it decays under level 59. Simply Home Teleport teleport to Oo'glog lodestone and bathe in the mud bath. Step out of it and immediately cast the Ourania Teleport. Upon arrival, run to the young trees and set up a trap as quickly as possible. With a bit of luck, the challenge will be completed rather easily.

pick a papaya or coconut from the fruit tree patch near Tree Gnome Village.

It takes about 16 hours for these trees to grow. It does not have to be a new tree.

attempt to steal blood runes from any of the three chests in the Chaos Druid Tower's dungeon. The attempt does not need to be successful. Merely attempting to open the chest will complete the achievement.

use a catapult in a Castle Wars game after gaining the knowledge from the Catapult Construction quest.

Just use a rock, found on a table on the, with a catapult and shoot. Players do not need to hit anyone or anything. It is strongly recommended to do this when Castle Wars is the spotlighted minigame.

For non-ironman:

Catch a raw manta ray in the Fishing Trawler minigame. To obtain the raw manta ray, check the trawler net on the docks west of the ship after completing a round. Fishing level boosts such as fishing potions (+3) and admiral pies (+5) may be used. Boosts can be used right before checking the trawler net as the required level does not have to be met during the activity itself.
It is a common misconception that this requires finding a group, but the minigame can be played, and the achievement completed, all solo. Players simply need to complete one round of the minigame with a high Fishing level in order to obtain manta rays. Obtaining this fish is not a matter of luck; even catching one fish during the minigame will result in the fish being a manta ray provided players have the requisite Fishing level.

For ironmen:

Successfully cook a rocktail on the Witchaven dock. As there is no range in Witchaven to cook, players must light a fire near Col. O'Niall then cook the rocktail.

runecraft at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar while having an abyssal titan familiar hold pure essence.

Essence held in runecrafting pouches will work. However, using a legendary pet with the "Beast of Burden" ability will not; the legendary pet must be dismissed and the Beast of Burden itself summoned using the pouch.

pick the lock on the door to the basement of the Yanille Agility dungeon. A lockpick or hair clip is required to pick the door's lock. The door is near the dungeon's southern entrance, close to the Yanille bank. The door must be unlocked from the southern side, as it is not locked when entered from the north. Temporary skill boost can be used to meet the level 82 Thieving requirement. Despite the official description, the player must succeed in picking the lock to complete the achievement.

remove pure or impure essence from a giant pouch at the Ourania Runecrafting Altar. A giant pouch requires level 75 Runecrafting to use and can be bought from Wizard Korvak in the Runecrafting Guild for or obtained as a drop from abyssal monsters. An expansive pouch will work. Pure essences must be manually removed from pouch for this achievement to count. Crafting essences directly on the altar will consume essences in all pouches but will not count for the achievement.

make a bane crossbow from scratch, performing each step within either Witchaven or Yanille. A main-hand bane crossbow is required; an off-hand or 2h crossbow will not grant the achievement. Players may obtain magic logs, raw meat, and a bane bar beforehand when completing this achievement. The only meat which will work is raw beef, raw wolf meat, raw bear meat, or raw yak meat.

kill a cave crawler in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon. Fairy ring is just west of the entrance to the dungeon.

Players can optionally bring an antipoison potion as a cave crawler can poison a player as the name of the achievement suggests.
kill five rock crabs on the shore near Rellekka or on Waterbirth Island.
find the windswept tree, which is the highest tree in the Fremennik Province mainland. It is located north-east of the Keldagrim entrance, next to the fairy ring with code.

talk to Captain Cain and view the rewards in the Barbarian Assault tutorial.

Players may use the games necklace to get there quickly. Players cannot have any runes or arrows or they will not be able to view the tutorial.

speak to Otto Godblessed about Barbarian Training.

Otto can be found in his house, Otto's Grotto, a little north of the Baxtorian Falls and south-west of the Barbarian Outpost.

A games necklace is recommended to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost and then walk south-west to his house.

collect three seaweed from the shore north-east of Rellekka.

The same seaweed can be dropped and picked up 3 times.

find the hunting expert at the Rellekka Hunter area.

To the east of Olaf Hradson (he is north of the fairy ring ), is a path leading northward. Stay on this path to reach a big ice platform with stairs. Go up the stairs, and find the hunting expert in the north-west corner.

catch a fish off one of Rellekka's piers.

Players can complete this achievement by catching raw shrimps, or by using Barbarian Fishing.

Raw lobsters, raw sharks, and raw great white sharks however do not count for this achievement.
kill an adult black unicorn.

learn the history of the Fremennik and the outerlanders from Brundt the Chieftain in the Rellekka Long Hall Bar, north of the main southern gate of Rellekka.

All 3 options must be used.

watch a shouting match between the tower guards of Jatizso and Neitiznot. Only starting The Fremennik Isles is required to unlock this achievement.

The towers are where Jatizso and Neitiznot face each other across a strait, one on each side. Take the boat from the northern-most pier in Rellekka. From Jatizso, go west, through the city, to the tower, or east for Neitiznot. Climb the tower, right-click the guard and select "Watch-shouting". This process takes about 40 seconds.

interact with a pet rock.

If the pet rock is lost, it can be re-obtained from Askeladden in front of the entrance of the Rellekka Long Hall Bar.
make 3 vials in the furnace room (the western-most building in Rellekka) which requires 3 pieces of molten glass.

go to the Fossegrimen and charm her into accepting a raw bass. Sacrifice a raw bass while having an uncharged enchanted lyre in the inventory and having the ring of charos (a) equipped, and talk to the Fossegrimen to have the lyre recharged. She is located south-west of Rellekka.

The lyre must not be fully charged (60 charges) for this to work, so be sure to use at least one charge before attempting this achievement.

This must be done at the altar; the remote contact option on the Fremennik sea boots 1 does not count.

wear yak-hide armour and kill an ice troll.

An ice troll (either male or female) that is across the bridges of either Neitiznot or Jatizso must be killed for it to work. Ice troll runts underground in the Jatizso dungeon mine will not work. Neitiznot's trolls must be killed across the second set of bridges (snowy ground). The yak-hide armour top and legs must be worn. Protect from Ranged or Deflect Ranged is recommended. Additional armour and weapons can be equipped.

make a cheese wheel in the dairy churn in Rellekka with a bucket of milk. The dairy churn can be found inside the house connected to the chicken coop, directly east of the Rellekka Long Hall Bar.

A bucket of milk spawns in a building directly northeast of the dairy churn in Rellekka.

look at Yrsa's options for recolouring one's boots in her shoe store in Rellekka.

The boots do not need to be changed to complete this achievement. The player's main-hand, off-hand, and boot slots (including overrides) must be empty when talking to her.
successfully hunt a sabre-toothed kyatt at the Rellekka Hunter area. This requires the use of a teasing stick.
steal a fish from the fishing stall at the market in Rellekka.

kill three dagannoths in the first layer of the Waterbirth Island Dungeon.

Talk to Jarvald on the westernmost dock in Rellekka to reach the island. The dagannoths are weak to earth spells.

wear rock-shell, spined, or skeletal armour and have the locals in Rellekka use an honorific with one's Fremennik name.

The core three components of the full set (helm, body, legs) are needed in order to complete this achievement. The superior version of the armours does not work. Simply talk to a local in Rellekka.

It might be easier and cheaper to buy raw materials needed for the armour sets and then have them made by Skulgrimen for the rock-shell armour, Peer the Seer for the skeletal armour, or Sigli the Huntsman for the spined armour.

complete a lap of the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course.

Players can use a games necklace to get there quickly.
mine pure essence at the Lunar Isle mine.

make a barbarian pyre ship from arctic pine logs.

Requires chewed bones or mangled bones, use pyre area west of whirlpool bridge (guaranteed drop from lost barbarian or confused barbarian found in the Ancient Cavern). If mangled bones are used, a level 106 ferocious barbarian spirit will appear. It is not required to kill the spirit that emerges from the pyre.

bake an uncooked pie using the Lunar spell Bake Pie which requires the player to be on the Lunar spellbook. The spell can be found in the Skilling tab of the Magic panel and requires 1 astral, 5 fire, and 4 water runes.

Players must have the Cooking level required for the pie that they are trying to bake.

get mahogany logs from one's Etceterian subjects in Managing Miscellania.

Sufficient coins in the royal coffers combined with sufficiently high approval rating for a minimum time duration of one day are required.

37,500 coins for one day with 100% approval should yield 1 mahogany log. Players may also simply change one gatherer to mahogany before they collect their resources for this achievement to be completed.

catch a raw shark with bare hands on Jatizso. Catching a raw great white shark at this location will work. Catching a shark with the Bait and Switch Archaeology relic power will also count.

Fishing boosts will work. The admiral pie may be used to complete this achievement at level 91 Fishing. Strength boosts work as well.

complete a lap of the high-level section of the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course while wearing an agile top.

Agility boosts may be used both to obtain the agile top and finish the achievement.

craft at least 56 astral runes simultaneously, without using pouches or familiars.

Requires a full backpack (28 pieces) of pure essence. Boosts may be used, but players cannot use pouches or familiars.

Players may also use a powerburst of sorcery to double the rune essence multiplier meaning significantly less than 28 pieces of pure essence are required to complete the achievement. Catalytic anima stones can also be used to complete this achievement with only 40 Runecrafting.

kill an ice strykewyrm.

Finishing this achievement does not require a player to be assigned ice strykewyrms as a slayer assignment, but the player must be able to damage them while having at least level 93 Slayer during combat. This means either wearing a fire cape, any variant of the TokHaar-Kal cape or have purchased the ability to kill them which costs 2,000 Slayer points. Boosts such as the wild pie will work for this achievement after 28 November 2022 update that made all strykewyrms attack-able without task. If a player attempts to attack an ice strykewyrm via conventional means, even via a ring of recoil, deflection curses, or poison they will cause no damage.
jump the chasm in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon to gain quick access to the pyrefiends.

make a pyre ship from magic logs.

Boosts may be used, but the Firemaking and Crafting level must be level 85 at the same time, so it is advised to boost Firemaking with orange spicy stew and Crafting with crafting potions.

For this achievement mangled bones or chewed bones are required. Chewed bones can take quite a long time to collect, so it is advised to kill a confused barbarian inside the Ancient Cavern, or to loot the barbarian corpse there for mangled bones, though this may take a few tries.
smith a rune hasta at the anvil in Otto's Grotto using magic logs and a rune bar.

make a super ranging mix within Otto's Grotto.

It is not required to entirely make the super ranging mix, players just need to add caviar to a 2-dose super ranging potion inside Otto's Grotto to complete this achievement.

use a balmung to kill a dagannoth.

The dagannoth has to be in the Fremennik Province, for example in the Lighthouse dungeon.

Killing a dagannoth guardian or killing the dagannoths in the Chaos Tunnels will not complete the achievement.
pick five bananas from the banana plantation at Musa Point.
swing to the Moss Giant Island, found north-west of Brimhaven, using the rope swing.
mine a gold ore from the Karamja north-west mine, found to the north-west of Brimhaven.
travel from Musa Point to Port Sarim. This can be done by talking to the Customs officer, found on the dock east of Musa Point. It costs to travel, or nothing if using the ring of charos (a).

travel from Brimhaven to East Ardougne. This can be done by talking to the Customs officer, found on the dock north of Brimhaven. It costs 30 coins to travel, or nothing if using the ring of charos (a).

reach Cairn Isle, found north-west of Shilo Village.

Players must climb the rocks then cross a bridge in order to reach the island. This requires level 15 Agility, though higher Agility levels reduce the chance of failure. The quickest way of reaching Cairn Isle is by using fairy ring and running south-west.
catch any fish from the fishing spots at Musa Point. They can be caught using at any spot, and using barehand fishing also counts.

compete in either the TzHaar Fight Pit or TzHaar Fight Cave. These activities can be found within TzHaar City.

Only competing in one of the activities is required.

slay a jogre in the Pothole Dungeon.

As jogres are level 57 and are aggressive, it is advised to take combat gear and food. They are weak to water spells, so Magic is advised.

obtain an Agility Arena ticket from the Agility Arena in Brimhaven.

A ticket can be claimed by tagging a pillar with a flashing arrow above it. Though it is possible to complete this achievement at any Agility level, level 40 Agility is recommended as this allows the player to cross all obstacles and reduces the likelihood of failing.

open the hidden door in the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.

It can only be opened from the Crandor side initially and as such requires Dragon Slayer to access it. It is located by the lesser demons on the Crandor side and the deadly red spiders on the Karamja side.

Completing this achievement also completes Cran Door's Secret.

travel to Crandor from Karamja via the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon.

This can be done by opening the hidden door in the dungeon. It can only be opened from the Crandor side initially and as such requires partial completion of Dragon Slayer to access it. It is located by the lesser demons on the Crandor side and the deadly red spiders on the Karamja side. The players are required to travel all the way north and climb the climbing rope at the end of the dungeon in order to complete the achievement.

use the Shilo Village cart system to travel from Shilo Village to Brimhaven or vice versa.

This can be done by paying to either Vigroy, found west of the Shilo Village bank, or Hajedy, found in northern Brimhaven.

earn 100% favour in Tai Bwo Wannai.

This can be done by completing the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup activity.

Trading in favour for trading sticks is not required to complete this achievement. If the player is already at 100% favour, then favour must be lowered then regained to complete this achievement.

cook a spider on stick.

To cook this, obtain a spider carcass and skewer stick (made from any thatch spar). Use the carcass on the skewer stick to create a raw spider on stick then cook it on a fire.

travel to Port Khazard from Cairn Isle via the Lady of the Waves.

The ship can be found on a dock directly south of Cairn Isle. Buy a ship ticket from Captain Shanks, which costs a random amount between 20-50 coins.
cut teak logs from a teak tree in Karamja. This can be done in Musa Point or in the south of Musa Point. Special teak logs will also count.
cut mahogany logs from a mahogany tree in Karamja. This can be done to the south of Cairn Isle. Special mahogany logs will also count.

catch a raw karambwan.

They can only be caught using a karambwan vessel and require a raw karambwanji as bait.

obtain a machete from Safta Doc.

Safta Doc sells jewelled machetes of varying types. In order to buy one, he requires a gout tuber, three uncut gems of the type used for the machete and trading sticks. He charges three cut or uncut opals and 300 trading sticks for an opal machete, three cut or uncut jades and 600 trading sticks for a jade machete, and three cut or uncut red topazes and 1200 trading sticks for a red topaz machete.

Players must be in clean-up mode and have spoken to Murcaily beforehand for the chat option in order for a machete to appear.

Repairing a fence in the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup is required to trade with Safta Doc.

travel from the Tree Gnome Stronghold to Karamja via gnome glider.

The gnome glider can be found at the top of the Grand Tree. Simply speak to Captain Errdo and select "Gandius".

grow any fruit tree in the Farming patch north of Brimhaven.

Plant any fruit tree sapling in the patch and optionally pay Garth to protect the tree. Once it is fully grown, check its health.

trap a horned graahk.

They can be found in the Karamja Hunter area, south of Tai Bwo Wannai. Build a trap over the pits, requiring any standard logs, then use a teasing stick to entice a horned graahk to give chase. Jump over the trap, which will cause the graahk to walk into it. However, it may also jump the trap. As such, it is recommended to build at least two traps.

cut a the vines within Brimhaven Dungeon to gain access to the deeper areas.

 must be paid to Saniboch to gain access to the dungeon. Any hatchet bar the blessed hatchet can be used to cut the vines.

climb the stairs within Brimhaven Dungeon, leading up to the Greater demons.

Players must pay Saniboch to gain access to the dungeon.

charter a ship from the shipyard, found to the far east of Karamja.

The password for the shipyard is Ka-Lu-Min. The Trader Crewmembers can be found at the southern-most dock. If Monkey Madness has been started, then the shipyard portion of the quest must be completed. The cheapest destination is Karamja, which costs . This can be reduced to by completing Cabin Fever and equipping a ring of charos (a), which reduce the price by 50% individually and 75% when combined.
mine an uncut ruby from a precious gem rock, found in Shilo Village.

win at the TzHaar Fight Pit.

The player only needs to be the last person standing. They can ask somebody to join them in the game for an easy kill, however, each player involved needs to attack the other(s) in order for the winning player to register the achievement.

kill a Ket-Zek in the TzHaar Fight Cave.

The Ket-Zek start appearing on wave 31 of the TzHaar Fight Caves. For tactics on completing the Fight Cave, see the strategies for the TzHaar Fight Cave.

eat an oomlie wrap.

The oomlie wrap can be eaten anywhere and does not have to be made to count for the achievement. It can be made by combining raw oomlie with a palm leaf then cooking it, requiring level 50 Cooking.

craft some nature runes.

The runes must be crafted at the nature altar, regardless of whether it is accessed via the ruins in Karamja, the Abyss, or the Great Orb Project.

Runes crafted in Daemonheim will not count.

cook a raw karambwan.

Players must talk to Tiadeche in Tai Bwo Wannai in order to learn how to properly cook a raw karambwan. Otherwise, they will only cook poison karambwan, which will not work for the achievement.

kill a deathwing in the Viyeldi caves, located beneath the Kharazi Jungle.

To traverse the cave, be sure to bring a lockpick and a pickaxe (if you do not have them on your toolbelt already). These are required to enter the ancient gate. As the deathwing is level 77 combat, combat gear is advised. As they are weak to arrows, Ranged gear is advised.

use the strong tree shortcut from Musa Point to southern Karamja.

Players will need an iron crossbow or better and a mithril grapple. The shortcut can be found just east of Stiles.

collect five palm leaves.

They can be obtained by shaking Leafy Palm Trees in the Kharazi Jungle. Dropping a leaf then picking it up again counts as multiple pieces being picked up.

obtain a Slayer assignment from Duradel in Shilo Village.

Duradel will only assign tasks to players with a combat level of 100 and level 50 Slayer. If he is unavailable during or after While Guthix Sleeps, Lapalok can be used to complete this achievement instead.

kill a metal dragon in Brimhaven Dungeon.

It is advised to bring good gear and antifire protection. Bronze dragons are the weakest dragons which can be killed for the achievement.

equip either a fire cape or TokHaar-Kal within TzHaar City.

The TzHaar Fight Cave or Fight Kiln must be completed in order to earn either of the capes. For tactics, see strategies for TzHaar Fight Cave and strategies for Fight Kiln.

trap a baby monkey using a box trap.

Bananas are used as bait for baby monkeys. Using a clockwork box trap will not work.

buy a clean snapdragon from Pirate Jackie the Fruit for 10 Agility Arena tickets and create a super restore potion from scratch within Brimhaven.

A clean snapdragon, red spiders' eggs and vial of water are required to make the potion. Red spiders' eggs can be obtained from the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon, or purchased on the Grand Exchange. The snapdragon must be mixed with the vial of water to create a snapdragon potion (unfinished) then used with the red spiders' eggs to finish off the potion, entirely within Brimhaven.

cook a raw shark on a sulphur pit, located within TzHaar City.

A bonfire made in the city will also work. Raw great white sharks cannot be used for the achievement.

have a chameleon following them while on Cairn Isle.

Either a baby or adult chameleon can be used for the achievement.
cross over the river in Shilo Village by using the stepping stones.
defeat Bork.

speak to Zimberfizz (or Zanik during and after Nomad's Elegy) about swapping one's Soul Wars cape for one of a different colour.

Speak to Zimberfizz (or Zanik) to claim a Soul Wars cape if needed.
chop down a magic tree in the Varrock Sewers resource dungeon. The tree has to be fully chopped down; just having obtained logs is not enough.

incinerate a log with the inferno adze, by cutting a tree in the tree patch in Varrock Palace courtyard. A Firemaking boost will not allow players to wield the inferno adze and activate the adze's special effect.

Growing an oak by planting an acorn is the cheapest method and will grow the fastest. Optionally, a basket of tomatoes can be used to pay the nearby farmer, Treznor, to protect the patch.

tell Sil'as Dahcsnu the player is the leader of the Dagon'hai. After doing so, he will attempt to cast a mind control spell which will then backfire on him.

The Magic level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.

bake a summer pie in the Cooks' Guild from scratch by following the steps below:


# Make pastry dough by mixing a pot of flour with water by using the pot of flour on the pump and drain.
# Use the pastry dough on a pie dish.
# Add a strawberry, watermelon, and cooking apple to the shell (in that order).
#* The cooking apple can be found in the Guild, the rest needs to be brought from outside.
# Bake the raw summer pie.
#* The pie must be baked on one of the ranges of the Cooks' Guild. Using the Bake Pie spell inside the Cooks' Guild will not count.
#* Ranges can be found on the or after having completed the hard Varrock achievements also on the.
defeat a skeleton at Senntisten altar (or pray at Senntisten altar) with Soul Split enabled.

craft 100 earth runes simultaneously without aid from an explorer's ring, pouches or familiars. If owned, the infinity ethereal outfit may be worn, although rune essence must not be stored within the outfit in order to complete the achievement. A ring of imbuing can be worn, lowering the required Runecrafting level.
pick poison ivy from the bush farming patch west of the Champions' Guild, south of Varrock, after having grown the bush themselves with a poison ivy seed. This cannot be assisted.
use the crevice shortcut in the Varrock Sewers, near the moss giants.
smith an adamant med helm on the anvil in Varrock next to Aubury's Rune Shop. Smithing the helm requires 2 adamant bars.

speak to Orlando Smith (or Mark Brodie during and after The World Wakes) by the central staircase, downstairs in the Varrock Museum, after earning a minimum of 153 kudos.

A player can earn a maximum of 198 kudos in the Varrock Museum activity through 5 different methods:
* by cleaning finds (50 kudos)
* by answering a Natural history quiz about museum exhibits given by Orlando Smith (or Mark Brodie, who is found at the same location, if you have completed The World Wakes) in the basement (28 kudos)
* by relating details of certain completed quests to Historian Minas (95 kudos)
* by completing the Dahmaroc statue for the first time (10 kudos)
* by completing the following requirements and talking to Mr. Mordaut in his office in the basement of the museum. Talking to him on Anachronia will not work (15 kudos)
** Complete both A Tail of Two Cats and Ritual of the Mahjarrat
** Kill the King Black Dragon or obtain Last riders
** Defeat the Queen Black Dragon for the First dragonkin journal

Players can speak to the Information clerk on the of the Varrock Museum to receive suggestions on how to receive more Kudos.

talk to Romily Weaklax and give him a wild pie.

Romily can be found inside the Cooks' Guild which requires the player to wear one of the following items to be allowed to enter the guild: chef's hat, (modified) sous chef's toque, cooking cape, or max cape.
craft an air battlestaff by using an air orb on a battlestaff.
talk to the estate agent in eastern Varrock and ask about player housing.

make a Varrock teleport tablet on a mahogany demon lectern or mahogany eagle lectern which requires 1 piece of soft clay, 1 fire rune, 3 air runes, and 1 law rune.

This can be done at another player's house, but an Ironman Mode player cannot use another player's house.

obtain a new set of Family Crest gauntlets from Dimintheis.

Players need to first destroy their previous gauntlets if they still have them and then talk to Dimintheis again. The gauntlets are free to reclaim.

There are 3 variations of the gauntlets; chaos gauntlets, cooking gauntlets, and smelting gauntlets.
make a waka canoe near Edgeville.
use the Home Teleport spell in the Ancient Magicks spellbook to teleport to Edgeville.
use the skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village.
trade two dashing kebbit furs and 800 coins with the fancy dress seller for a spottier cape.
catch a raw mackerel with a big fishing net (which can be stored on the tool belt) at a Net/Harpoon fishing spot at Catherby beach. The net may be bought at Harry's Fishing Shop in Catherby.

buy a white candle from the Candle-maker at Catherby docks which costs .

Black candles will not complete the achievement.
pick 5 flax at the flax field south of Seers' Village.

spin 5 flax into bowstrings at the spinning wheel inside a small building on the located in Seers' Village. Use the ladder in the building to go upstairs to the spinning wheel.

Using the Spin Flax spell from the lunar spells will not complete this achievement.
pray at the altar in the church in Seers' Village or alternatively the altar at Camelot. It can be completed even with Prayer points already full.

walk clockwise around the mysterious statue which is located east of the bank in Seers' Village.

Players can run or walk around the statue. Players must start at the east end of the statue and cannot stop until they have made a full cycle, or they will have to start again. Walking around the statue without pausing is easier than running.

Players must turn off walk animations in order to complete this achievement.
plant 3 jute seeds in the patch north of McGrubor's Wood. The plant does not need to be harvested, raking the patch and planting the seeds will suffice for this achievement.
have Sir Galahad make the player a cup of tea who can be found in his house west of McGrubor's Wood.

take a poison chalice to King Arthur at Camelot.

Poison chalice may be obtained for free from Stankers at the coal truck mine. Be careful not to drink it. After getting a poison chalice, teleport to Camelot and use the poison chalice on King Arthur at the of Camelot Castle. Although Arthur will first state that the player has "chosen poorly", he will then correct himself and remark that he actually enjoys Stankers' concoctions.

Level 20 Agility is required to use the shortcut from the side of McGrubor's Wood to the mining site. Alternatively, players can access the mining site from the side of the Fishing Guild.
fill five pots with flour from the barrel full of flour in the kitchen of the Sinclair Mansion. Fill a single pot five times, emptying after each refill to reuse the pot.

use the churn in the Sinclair Mansion garden.

A bucket of milk can be obtained by using a bucket on the dairy cow in the garden. Players can alternatively obtain a bucket of milk by purchasing from the milk seller for 12 coins. The churn is just north from the stall.

Sometimes, when making butter or cheese wheels, the achievement will finish before the milk is used. Players do not have to finish churning if this occurs.

use the log balance shortcut between the Sinclair Mansion and the Fremennik Province.

Head north, just outside the fence of the mansion, towards the river. This achievement is boostable with items such as a summer pie.

talk to Thormac the sorcerer about making mystic staves. Thormac can be found at the top of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seers' Village. Players do not need to actually get him to enchant their staff, just talk to him about it.

transport a full load of 224 pieces of coal to Seers' Village from the coal truck mine.

Alternatively, the coal can be taken from the player's bank into the nearest Coal Truck one can deposit into. This negates the need for level 20 Mining. The fastest method is to carry the coal to the coal trucks in the small building north of the Seers' Village pub with a Beast of Burden familiar to help carry the coal. Once the achievement is done, the coal can be retrieved again.
find the highest point in Seers' Village.

defeat each type of elemental in the elemental workshop.

Defeating the earth elemental from Mining will also count. So will killing a fire elemental near the dust devils in the Smoke Dungeon.

teleport to Camelot.

The Camelot teleport spell is only available in the standard spellbook.

The Camelot teleport tablets do not work for this achievement; neither will a player-owned house portal.

kill one Tower Archer on each tower of the Ranging Guild using a regular longbow.

Enter the guild and go up the ladder in the middle of the guild. From the centre tower, kill 1 Tower Archer at each of the 4 towers on the corners of the guild. They range in level from 14 to 56 (north tower: level 14, east: 28, south: 42, west: 56), so you may need to bring food and prayer potions (for Protect from Ranged), if you have a low Ranged level. All 4 need to be killed in one go, so don't go back down the ladder until you've killed 1 at each tower. The final blow to each archer must be done with a regular longbow (oak longbow or above will not count). Alternatively players can kill them with whatever Ranged weapon they want if they switch to longbow while the finishing blow is travelling to their target.

have the Competition Judge from the Ranging Guild competition congratulate the player for acquiring at least 1,000 archery tickets. Contrary to the in-game description, the player does not need more than 1,000 tickets.

Bring some coins for the entrance fee (200 coins per game). Players with a high Ranged level with good bonuses, may likely play about 40 games before obtaining 1,000 tickets so bring 6,000-10,000 coins to pay for the multiple tries it will take. Players with level 70+ Ranged with a yew bow should be able to complete it in less than 25 turns. Lower-level players may have to play closer to 100 games, so bring 20,000 coins. Alternatively, players can buy 1,000 tickets from the Grand Exchange for.

buy something from the Ticket Exchange in the Ranging Guild.

The studded leather coif is the cheapest at 12 archery tickets.
use a pyrelord or forge regent familiar to make a fire with maple logs within Seers' Village.

get a pet fish from Harry by using a tiny net (can be bought from Harry, at a cost of 10 coins each).

Players must first fill a fishbowl with water, use seaweed with the water-filled fishbowl, and then talk to Harry or the option to buy the tiny net will not appear.

catch a raw bass in Catherby beach at a Net/Harpoon fishing spot, and then cook it either at a fire or at the range in the building north of the bank.

Burning the fish will not count for this achievement.

teleport to the Ranging Guild with a combat bracelet which has at least one charge.

Teleporting using a jewellery box will not complete this achievement.

cut five sets of yew logs. The logs must be cut from the yew trees found in the Seers' Village area, otherwise it will not count. Using the inferno adze will only count cut logs if they are not incinerated. A grace of the elves can be used during this task to cut down on banking.

use the fairy ring (code ) in McGrubor's Wood.

Dramen staff or lunar staff are required, unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

burn a magic log in Seers' Village.

Players can use a tinderbox (can be on tool belt) or a pyrelord or forge regent familiar; using a bow doesn't work.

catch five sharks at Catherby beach.

Alternatively, players can catch a shark at level 71 Fishing if an admiral pie is used, or at level 73 if a fish pie or fishing potion is used.

Catching two sharks at once only counts as one in the achievement. Great white sharks do count towards this achievement.

cook five sharks in Catherby using the cooking gauntlets.

Either range can be used. Burnt sharks do not count towards the five, and they do not have to be cooked all at once. Great white sharks also do not count towards the five, despite counting for Gonna Need a Bigger Boat. The sharks can be cooked at level 76 with a Chef's delight, at level 75 with a Chef's delight (m), or at level 74 with an Advanced pulse core explosion.

use the grapple shortcut to get from the Obelisk of Water island to Catherby beach. A mithril grapple and a crossbow are required to use the shortcut. You must enter the Taverley Dungeon, climb the ladder at the black dragons area, then grapple the grapple column and you will complete this achievement. Alternatively, one can use the hidey-hole or the enhanced grappling hook (on the tool belt).

charge five water orbs in one go at the Obelisk of Water on the island south of Catherby beach.

The player must use the standard Magic spellbook and cast a Charge Water Orb on the Obelisk of Water using 150 water runes or a staff supplying water runes, 15 cosmic runes, and 5 unpowered orbs.

Teleport to the Taverley lodestone, walk south (either using the stepping stones agility shortcut or walking around over the bridge), then enter the Taverley Dungeon. From there, head towards the north-west corner of the dungeon, using either the Agility shortcut (requires 70 agility) or walking around the dungeon (requires a dusty key). You are looking for the ladder next to the black dragons which will lead you back to the surface, next to the Obelisk of Water. In the dungeon, level 64 poison spiders can be encountered; their poison can halt the orb-making process, resulting in orbs being made but the achievement not being completed. Therefore, bring an antipoison potion. It's recommended to bring a mithril grapple and crossbow for the next achievement, Island Hopper.

make an enchanted diamond-tipped crossbow bolt from scratch within the Seers' Village area.

# Smith adamant bolts (unf)
# Craft diamond bolt tips
# Fletch bolt with feather and add bolt tip
# Cast Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Diamond) on the bolts

Each step needs to be completed within the area, and the achievement will be updated in the achievement tab as steps are completed. The adamant bar, diamond, and feathers can be brought in.

make a magic longbow from scratch within the Seers' Village area.

# Fletch a magic longbow (unstrung)
# Pick and spin flax
# String the bow

Each step needs to be completed within the area, and the achievement will be updated in the achievement tab as steps are completed. The magic logs can be brought in.

cast Fertile Soil on a farming patch in Catherby or the hops patch north-west of Seers' Village.

The allotment south of the Ranging Guild will not work.
mine some clay at the Draynor mine, located north-east of the Draynor lodestone and south-east of Draynor Manor.
kill anything on the of the Slayer Tower.
craft a snelm in Morytania by killing any snail in the Mort Myre Swamp and using a chisel on its shell.
cook a thin snail in Morytania. There's a cooking range in Port Phasmatys, and there are many dead trees from which logs can be chopped and lit to make a fire.

kill a werewolf in its human form using the wolfbane dagger whilst in Canifis.

As the wolfbane dagger is a melee weapon, players should not wear range or magic gear that lowers melee hit chance. This will prevent them from doing any damage while wielding the wolfbane dagger. Melee armour is recommended for this task. It is not possible to complete the achievement while dual wielding another weapon with the wolfbane dagger.

If dropped or lost, the dagger can be reclaimed by talking to Drezel in the basement of Paterdomus. Any version of the reforged Sunspear can be used after River of Blood.

The achievement can no longer be done without the dagger by killing the target in a single hit, preventing the transformation. The max hit for a human is 1000, after which it transforms into its werewolf state.
finish a game of Werewolf Skullball. Remember to bring the ring of charos which is required to enter the course.

restore and boost one's prayer points at the altar in the Nature Grotto.

Partially drained prayer points will work.

kill a ghast in Morytania.

Players will need a full druid pouch to make the ghast attackable. Killing ghasts in Temple Trekking does count towards this achievement.

grow some fungus in the Mort Myre Swamp using the Bloom option of either a blessed silver sickle or the Ivandis flail.

40 prayer points are required to cast the spell. Players can recharge their prayer points at the altar in the Nature Grotto after completion of the Nature Spirit quest.

Temple Trekking provides a short-cut to the Grotto as a reward.

kill anything on the of the Slayer Tower.

Bats count if they are inside the tower, though the double agent from Treasure Trails does not.

harvest a limpwurt root in the flower patch near Port Phasmatys.

It's ideal to start the achievement by planting a limpwurt seed at the flower patch first. Using supercompost is recommended. Alternatively, a Supreme growth potion (leafy) can also be used to instantly grow the plant.

take a trip on a charter ship to the Port Phasmatys dock.

Some coins and having entered Port Phasmatys is required for this achievement. Ecto-tokens are not required when travelling by ship.

The cheapest charter is from Musa Point at 275 coins with a ring of charos (a) (1,100 coins without it).
complete a Temple Trekking route from Paterdomus to Burgh de Rott.

use an ectophial to return to Port Phasmatys.

If lost, the ectophial can be reclaimed from Velorina, the ghost who started the Ghosts Ahoy quest.

exchange 5 ecto-tokens for brewing yeast with Metarialus in the The Green Ghost inn's cellar while having an empty pot in the inventory.

A ghostspeak amulet or cramulet is not required to purchase yeast from Metarialus if using the right-click 'buy yeast' option.

Players may wish to keep or use the yeast for the The Beer Inn-spectre task in the same area.

use a Flamtaer hammer to help fix the Shades of Mort'ton temple.

The Flamtaer hammer can be purchased from Razmire Keelgan in Mort'ton for 13,000 coins.

use the fairy rings to travel to fairy ring in the Haunted Woods.

A dramen staff or lunar staff is required to use the fairy ring network unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

obtain some bark from hollow trees.

Hollow trees are located east of Canifis in the Haunted Woods. It may take several attempts to get bark; most of the time nothing is obtained.

Keep the bark, there is a hard achievement, Better Than Cursing The Darkness, that needs it.
enter through the western gate of Port Phasmatys which requires either 2 ecto-tokens and a ghostspeak amulet or completion of Ghosts Ahoy.

take a medium companion through a medium route of Temple Trekking.

Simply choose a medium companion at the Temple Trekking start point. Make sure to select 'Confirm' rather than 'Quick Start', otherwise the achievement will not prompt. And guide them through a medium route. Sometimes it won't count unless the continue-medium path button was clicked.
unlock a chest in the Shade Catacombs. See this for more information.

trap a green salamander in the Haunted Woods.

Players will need a rope and a small fishing net for the net trap (the net on the tool belt does not work).

The hunting area is marked by a Hunter training map icon.png Hunter Training symbol on the map, it's directly south of the entrance to the Werewolf Skullball minigame.

mix a Guthix balance potion while in Morytania.

Add garlic to a 3-dose restore potion, then add silver dust. Silver dust is obtained by grinding silver bars in the bone grinder on the upper floor of the Ectofuntus. If the garlic is obtained from the chest in the Myreque Hideout in Burgh de Rott, do not create the potion just yet. Making the potion in the hideout does not count as being in Morytania.

start any ale brewing below The Green Ghost Inn.

Required are 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, ale yeast and the main ingredient for the ale one wants to brew.

Cider does work to complete this achievement. For this, the players need 4 buckets of apple mush (4 buckets and 16 cooking apples), and ale yeast, but not the buckets of water or the barley malt.

use the Telekinetic Grab spell to pick up the pickled brain on a table in the Hair of the Dog bar in Canifis. This requires 1 law rune and 1 air rune and the player needs to be on the standard spellbook.

explore the tunnel from the cellar under the Hair of the Dog bar in Canifis.

The tunnel is located under a trapdoor at the back of the Hair of the Dog inn, not inside. If the tunnel shortcut is unlocked by levelling Zachory Bragg to 99 in the Temple Trekking minigame, players may have to toggle the trapdoor's function back to normal.

Players can also enter the tunnel from the opposite direction in the Mort Myre Swamp.
make a batch of cannonballs in Port Phasmatys requiring one steel bar and an ammo mould which can be on the tool belt.

harvest bittercap mushrooms in the mushroom patch west of Canifis which requires a bittercap mushroom spore.

This can take up to 240 minutes (4 hours) to grow, however this can be expedited by using a supreme growth potion (sundry) obtained from the player-owned farm for 1000 beans, or from Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 7,500 Crux Eqal favour . Players may use boosts to complete this achievement, such as pork pie at Farming level 48, but they must be redone before harvesting to complete the achievement.

mine the mithril vein in the north-west corner of level 2 of the Abandoned Mine.

The mithril vein is on the northern wall, near the western large door.

A crystal-mine key (steel key ring with the key added works) is required. Climb down the stairs found on the surface at the north-east part of the Abandoned Mine, open the large doors to the west. Mine the mithril ore vein on the northern wall.
view the stock in Razmire Builders' Merchants shop. Must use serum 207 or serum 208 on Razmire Keelgan to gain access to the shop.

kill Tarn Razorlor (or visit his lair if he's already dead).

Players may use a ring of slaying for quick access.

break a blood altar teleport tablet which can be bought at the Runecrafting Guild for 45 Runecrafting guild tokens, or from Wizard Rinsit's Runecrafting Shop for 2,000 Runespan points.

The level for the Runecrafting requirement can be boosted, either by talking to Oldak, or by using spicy stews.
cast Bloom using an Ivandis flail, upgraded with at least 200 burnt vyre corpses.
hand in the stick at the end of the Werewolf Agility Course. Accessing the course requires a ring of charos.

use the broken Saradomin statue shortcut to cross the River Salve without going through the Paterdomus temple.

The shortcut can be crossed from either direction. A fast way to complete this achievement is to travel to fairy ring and then running north-west.

attune a portal in the portal chamber of a player-owned house to Kharyrll (modern day Canifis), or use the portal if it has already been attuned. Using a portal in another player's house will complete this achievement unless the player is an Ironman Mode player, in which case they must instead build and attune their own portal chamber and portal.

A Kharyrll portal may be assigned without needing the spellbook set to Ancient Magicks and requires 200 law runes, 100 blood runes, and level 66 Magic.

Using a portal nexus in a Player-owned house will not work.
equip any one item from a set of Barrows equipment in the Barrows. Equipment released alongside or after the Evolution of Combat will not work.

use a columbarium key to unlock an alcove in the Columbarium underneath Paterdomus. Shiny columbarium keys also work for this achievement.

Not to be confused with cremating shades in Mort'ton, vyre cremation only happens in the Columbarium and requires a vyre corpse and one set of teak pyre logs or better.

Be aware that the Columbarium is not in Morytania, so do not attempt to perform other Morytania achievements there.

fletch a blisterwood polearm within Morytania, requiring one set of blisterwood logs and two silver sickles.

The player must start and progress through The Branches of Darkmeyer to access the blisterwood tree, which is located in the arboretum in Darkmeyer. The quest requirements to start the quest are not boostable. Creating the polearm inside the Myreque Hideout in Meiyerditch will not count.

take a hard companion through a hard route of Temple Trekking or Burgh de Rott Ramble.

Simply choose a hard companion at the Temple Trekking or Burgh de Rott Ramble start point, and guide them through a hard route. Make sure to select 'Confirm' rather than 'Quick Start', otherwise the achievement will not prompt. There seems to be a chance of the achievement not awarding (even when selecting 'Confirm'), so several attempts may have to be done.
burn a Haunted Wood torch while wearing the ring of fire (from the All Fired Up minigame) and having a piece of bark in the inventory.
use Drakan's medallion to teleport to Darkmeyer.
kill an abyssal demon in the Slayer Tower. The achievement can not be completed using recoil damage.

craft blood runes at the blood altar.

This achievement can be done as low as level 71 using spicy stew with three doses of orange spice after completion of Evil Dave's Big Day Out. Alternatively, using a more reliable temporary skill boost, it can be done at level 72 with the use of extreme runecrafting potions. It is also doable at level 75 by talking to Oldak, as he can boost the player's Runecrafting level by ±2, with time for them to use a blood altar teleport tablet.

summon a ghast familiar in Morytania. Though In Aid of the Myreque is listed as a requirement in-game, players must complete The Darkness of Hallowvale to unlock Burgh de Rott Ramble. 

The ghast familiar may be claimed after getting all 6 followers in Temple Trekking and Burgh de Rott Ramble to level 99 (3 from Paterdomus to Burgh de Rott and 3 from Burgh de Rott to Paterdomus). This effectively makes Complete Trekky a requirement as well.

fish a raw shark using bare-handed fishing off the Burgh de Rott dock. Catching a raw great white shark at this location will work. Catching a shark with the Bait and Switch relic power will also count.

Temporary skill boosts may be used to complete this achievement; the admiral pie may be used at level 91 Fishing, and Strength boosts work as well.

burn a fiyr remains with magic pyre logs or elder pyre logs.

Fiyr remains can be bought on the Grand Exchange or obtained by killing Fiyr Shades, found on the hard route in the Mort'ton event of Temple Trekking or in the Shade Catacombs below Mort'ton.

If a key drop is not obtained, the achievement will not count and it will need to be tried again.

kill the first seven Barrows Brothers, including Akrisae the Doomed, but not Linza the Disgraced. They do not have to be killed in a single run, and Barrows amulets don't work.

See this page for strategies.
talk to Khoochak in the throne room of Al Kharid palace about a quest.

create a grand ranging potion in a crystal flask from nothing but herblore ingredients, performing each step within Prifddinas.

The following steps yield task completion:
* Mine crystal-flecked sandstone. It must be mined in the Ithell district; the rock in the Edimmu resource dungeon will not work.
* Blow it into crystal glass.
* Blow it into crystal flask.
* Combine the super ranging potion (4) and ranging potion (4) into the crystal flask to produce a grand ranging potion (requires purchasing the recipe from Lady Meilyr for ).
complete all Fremennik Sagas with 100% completion.

attempt to pass a tripwire in the Isafdar forest in Tirannwn.

One is found just north of the Tirannwn lodestone, on the path to a spawn of white berries.

complete a solo abandoned floor on any complexity.

Abandoned floors can be found on Dungeoneering floors 12-17.

complete Three's Company saga with 100%.

The Fremennik Saga can be started by talking to Skaldrun, after rescuing him from the Frozen floors 1-11 with high complexity.

start a Dungeoneering floor with 225 of any type of ammo in their bound loadout. Any type of arrow or runes works to complete this achievement. The achievement is only obtained by entering a solo dungeon and requires completion of the Salt in the Wound quest.

equip a ring of kinship with a fully upgraded role, e.g. Tank, Medic. It will cost a total of 168,332 Dungeoneering tokens to fully upgrade any given role to level 10. To complete the achievement, the ring has to be un-equipped and re-equipped again after the maxed role has been activated.

kill a rum-pumped crab, which can be found in the 'Rum'-geon on Braindeath Island.

To enter the resource dungeon the player needs a Fishbowl helmet and Diving apparatus which can be retrieved from Murphy. It is advised to bring Antipoison since General malpractitioners in the area will poison.

Followers and familiar pouches cannot be brought into the dungeon (even in an inventory).

use spiritbloom cloth to craft a spiritbloom orb and wield it. 

A strong artisan's potion may be used to boost Crafting if necessary, though the Magic requirement to wield the orb is not boostable.

deface the three paintings of Zemouregal in the palace's heart vault.

Search the footlocker in the north-eastern room on the for the vault key. After opening the vault's outer door on the  in the castle there are three paintings on the northern wall, click on them to deface.

offer some bones on the chaos altars in the Chaos Temple at level 12 Wilderness or Chaos Temple at level 38 Wilderness. Any kind of bones can be used. Spawns of regular bones can be found near the altar.

The altars are not the Runecrafting chaos altar which can be found at level 9 Wilderness.
deposit 50 cursed memories at the cursed Divination energy rift at the centre of the Wilderness Crater.

persuade Noterazzo in the Wilderness Bandit Camp to show his goods.

The bandits in the camp will be aggressive when the player is not skulled. To become skulled, select the 'Toggle PvP' option on Vala in Edgeville. Trade Noterazzo to open Bandit Duty Free.

catch a black salamander near the Boneyard in the Wilderness which requires a small fishing net, rope, and optionally harralander tar.

The Hunter level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted. It is possible to catch the salamander with a boost, but the achievement task will not completed.

Keep a black salamander to make the camouflage potion for the hard achievement What Potion?.

complete a task from each of the Slayer Masters consecutively. The player must start with Turael and work their way up to Laniakea. The player may use Spria, Achtryn, and Lapalok instead of Turael, Mazchna, and Duradel, respectively, if the player is progressing through or has completed the While Guthix Sleeps quest. The Raptor's tasks are not part of this achievement. In-game, Master Otto is shown to be required, but this achievement can be completed without it.

fully unlock all of the eagle transport system routes. The routes themselves are unlocked with the completion of Eagles' Peak and Back to my Roots, but two additional actions are required for the achievement (note that rope racks at the eyries do not need to be built to obtain the achievement): 

* Travel to the desert eyrie from the outside, east of the Dominion Tower, and push away a boulder, requiring .
* Travel to the Feldip eyrie from the outside and use a teasing stick, garden cane, or thatch spar to help grow a jungle vine to serve as a ladder. The vine takes approximately 40 minutes to grow.
pickpocket one of New Varrock's many zombie inhabitants.

use a lockpick to access Zemouregal's lost property chest in his study.

Enter the north-west room (the study) on the in the castle, passing the orange barrier.

The skill requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted.

do something to deal with New Varrock's stray cat problem.

The achievement requires the player to bring each cat the required item. Once all four have agreed to leave their location, they can be found at Fluff's grave at the western wall beside the New Varrock West bank.

use a lockpick to open any of New Varrock's treasure chests.

The 6 chests in a gang hideout can only be collected in one gang hideout or the other. Both can only be collected in one or the other. Both are not required and attempting to search the opposite gang stash on a second playthrough will show the chests as already looted. A lockpick is required.
sell something to one of New Varrock's many shops.
cook some meat from an undead source (cow or chicken).

find a way to silence Romeo's head, in Zemouregal's Study in New Varrock.

Bring cadava berries to the Apothecary to create a cadava potion (a potion that makes it seem like the person that drinks it is dead). A cadava berry bush can be found near the entrance of the Apothecary's house. Bring this potion to the heads on a chain in Zemouregal's study (, north-west section inside of his castle) which requires a vial of orange mist to enter.

use a lockpick to open half of New Varrock's treasure chests.

The 6 chests in a gang hideout can only be collected in one gang hideout or the other. Both can only be collected in one or the other. Both are not required and attempting to search the opposite gang stash on a second playthrough will show the chests as already looted.
use the scrying pool in the treasure room of Zemouregal's castle to spy on the citizens of New Varrock by clicking on the first 6 options.

smith or craft any piece of level 10 armour (iron, imphide or hardleather; head, body or legs). An easy way to complete this is to purchase a thread (4 zemomarks) and hardleather (1 zemomark) from the tanner's store, and craft the hardleather into any piece of armour.

make a Zemouregal brew for Tiny Zemouregal and give it to him.

A Zemouregal brew is made by following these steps:
* With an empty jug, get the wine of Zemouregal from the south-west room on the of the castle.
* Buy a doogle leaf from Xuan and combine it with a vial of water. A vial can be bought in the general store. It can be filled at the sink west of the church.
* Add the wine of Zemouregal.

use a lockpick to open all of New Varrock's treasure chests.

The six gang hideout chests can only be collected once from either the Black Arm Gang or the Phoenix Gang Hideout. Attempting to search the opposite gang's chests during a subsequent playthrough shows the chests as having already been looted.

infiltrate both the Black Arm Gang and the Phoenix Gang. This requires the player to complete Dimension of Disaster at least once and then join the opposite gang during Dimension of Disaster: Shield of Arrav.
inspect Fluffs' grave (on the west wall of New Varrock, near the west bank) twice after completing Cat's Bane.

go to the museum, press the big red button south of Orlando Smith and use all four options.

Each option corresponds to an ability from the Codex Ultimatus: Blood Tendrils, Smoke Tendrils, Shadow Tendrils and Ice Asylum. The skill requirement for each event option is identical to the corresponding ability, thus requiring high levels in certain combat skills. However, players are not required to read Codex Ultimatus before re-enacting an event.
defeat a New Varrock guard.

perform the Salute emote in New Varrock while wearing a full set of level 20 armour (steel med helm or full helm, platebody or chainbody, and platelegs or plateskirt; spider silk hood, robe top, and robe bottom; or studded leather coif, body, and chaps).

Players can get drops from New Varrock guards or receive the items in trade from other players. Alternatively, if Dimension of Disaster is completed, one could purchase the Sani & Zaff upgrade reward from Aris, reset the quest, and buy seven spider silk from Zaff's Superior Spellcasting. The full set of robes can then be crafted without killing guards.
damage Zemouregal at least five times with exploding cows when fighting him during Dimension of Disaster: Curse of Arrav.

talk to the Chief Servant at the Servants' Guild to find out about servants for a player-owned house. The Servants' Guild is located in the north-eastern corner of East Ardougne, just south-east of the Ardougne lodestone.

talk to Tindel Marchant about identifying swords. He is located at the end of the southern most pier in eastern Port Khazard. Merely asking him about swords is enough to complete the achievement, so a rusty sword is not required.
pick watermelons from the Farming patch north of East Ardougne. You need to first grow watermelons in the allotment patch in Ardougne and then return to harvest them when fully grown.

kill a swordchick in the Tower of Life.

To make a swordchick, a raw chicken and a raw swordfish need to be used on the south-western altar in the basement of the Tower of Life.

convert a blissful shadow core at the light rift located in the Amlodd Clan district of Prifddinas.

Blissful shadows in the Amlodd Clan district must be killed until one drops a blissful shadow core.

eagle-dive into a hay cart from on top of the Al Kharid bank after completing the Diamond in the Rough quest.

The spot where the player has to jump off can be reached by dropping off the west side of the roof of Al Kharid Palace, shimmying across the rope and then dropping off the rug to the south. Alternately, repeat the The creed section of the Stolen Hearts quest, and instead of using the grapple walk south and dive off the Al Kharid bank.

An alternative, faster route after the quest is to go up to the palace roof from the northwest staircase, drop off the west side, and then shimmy-across the rope to get to the roof of the bank.

equip a full set of desert clothing while standing in the desert.

The set can be bought from Shantay at Shantay Pass. Wearing either black desert robe or black desert shirt will not complete the achievement.
view the Memorial Board at the northern edge of Het's Oasis. The board is found near the Het's Oasis bank, south of the Mage Training Arena.

catch a golden warbler with the use of a bird snare. Golden warblers can be found just east of the Dominion Tower.

Protean traps do not work.
use any of the magic carpets in the desert.
fill a waterskin with water from a Kharidian cactus in the desert.
craft a fire rune at the fire altar, which can be found west of Het's Oasis.

obtain five artefacts from Pyramid Plunder.
