A Pharaoh's sceptre may be used to bypass the quest requirement to get into Pyramid Plunder, Ironmen will still have to start Icthlarin's Little Helper.

exchange Pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena, by buying any of the rewards.

They can exchange their points at the Rewards Guardian, which is located on the.
attempt to spectate on a match at the Dominion Tower.

perform the Troubadour Dance emote near the dancers outside the Citharede Abbey.

Using the 'dance-with' option on the dancers will not work. The player must use the Troubadour Dance emote from the emote tab in the chatbox.
ride an eagle to the desert by using a rope on the Desert eagle inside the Eagles' Peak Dungeon.

solve an easy Runedoku casket by choosing the "examine lock" option rather than force or pick lock.

If either the force or pick lock option is chosen, the player will have to wait till daily reset to try again.

cross the River Lum using a crossbow and mithril grapple.

The shortcut from Lumbridge Swamp to Al Kharid is located south of the Lumbridge cemetery. Equip the crossbow and grapple and click "grapple" on the strong tree on the Lumbridge side of the river. The enhanced grappling hook from the toolbelt works.
pray at the Elidinis Statuette in Nardah after the Spirits of the Elid quest.
travel to the Fairy ring that is located near the Kalphite Hive, by using the Fairy ring code.
sell a pyramid top to Simon, which can be obtained by completing the Agility Pyramid, and choosing the 'Climb Climbing rocks' option on the west side of the doorway before finishing the course.
mine granite at the desert quarry south of the Bandit Camp.

create a spirit kalphite pouch at the obelisk south-west of Pollnivneach across the river. In case you cannot locate it, it is actually on the opposite bank of the T.A.R.D.I.S. icy patch in the desert. The Obelisk is underground so you have to look out for a Desert Ladder to climb down.

Alternatively, you can create the pouch at the obelisk inside Psamtik's shop in Menaphos for this achievement to be recognised.

The pouch can be made with a blue charm, a pouch, 51 spirit shards, and a potato cactus.
cut a log from the teak tree near the Ruins of Uzer.

boost their stats at the Amascut's altar, which is located inside the Uzer Mastaba south of Uzer.

Completion of Missing My Mummy and repairing all the statues is required before gaining the option to pray at Amascut's statue.

equip a charged enchanted water tiara while in the desert.

The enchanted tiara can be made by using 3 water runes on a water tiara for each charge.

make an ugthanki kebab from raw ingredients in Nardah, all which can be bought from the Grand Exchange.

To make ugthanki kebab the player will need the following ingredients: an onion, a tomato, an empty bowl, raw ugthanki meat, a pot of flour, and a bucket of water.
fill a waterskin with the use of the Humidify spell, while standing in the Desert.
use the deposit chest near the Bedabin Camp. It is not required to bank an item.
listen to one of Al the Camel's poems using a fully upgraded cramulet.
enter the Al Kharid Resource Dungeon, which is located in the mining site north of Al Kharid.

use a dreadnip on the Kalphite Queen. Using it on the Exiled Kalphite Queen will not work. It is not necessary to kill the Kalphite Queen.

To avoid risking death or having to pay 100,000 coins, the achievement can be completed in practice mode.

fletch some broad-tipped bolts or arrows in Sumona's house.

To fletch broad bolts or arrows, the ability to do so must first be bought for 300 slayer points from any slayer master. 

One broad arrowheads and headless arrow are needed for the arrows, or one unfinished broad bolts and feather.

kill a scarab mage, locust rider or kalphite with the keris dagger.

Killing the scarab mage or locust rider in the Giant scarab fight in the Dominion Tower or killing scabarites in Ullek swamp will not count for the achievement, nor will using the primed keris and its variants.
cast the Ice Burst spell on an enemy in the Desert.

fill a waterskin from the fountain inside of the Enakhra's Temple.

Use the lodestone to Bandit Camp. Run south west around the edge of the rock formation to find the entrance to Enakhra's Temple. There will be a square opening in the ground and to the east of it is the option to 'Climb-down Secret entrance'. Climb down the ladder and make your way to the middle room. Go up the ladder. The fountain is to the west.

kill a Dust devil in the Smoke Dungeon.

It is recommended to wear a face mask, a slayer helmet, or a full slayer helmet to prevent them from lowering stats and dealing rapid damage to the player.

Having your slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand also works.

harvest spines from a self-grown cactus, which can be planted in the cactus patch in north-eastern Al Kharid using a cactus seed. Het's Oasis cactus patch does not count for this achievement.

For six cadava berries, the player can have the nearby farmer, Ayesha, protect it from disease.

A Supreme growth potion (leafy) can be used to expedite the process.

play the Holy Cithara while standing in the Citharede Abbey.

The Holy Cithara can be found by searching the reliquary in the basement of Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede after meeting certain "Holy" requirements.

equip the ankh, which can be found in the Apmeken tomb and the Scabaras mask, which can be found in the Scabaras tomb while in the Kharidian Desert.

Entering the desert while having the items already equipped will not complete the achievement.

make a super antifire flask from scratch in Nardah.

To make a super antifire flask, the player will the need following items: 2 phoenix feathers, 2 antifire (3), and a robust glass.
# Teleport to Nardah.
# Use both phoenix feathers on both antifire (3) to create 2 super antifire potions (3) (the instructions mistakenly say "make antifire potion" instead of "make super antifire potion". The player does not need to make the antifire potions from scratch, only the super antifire).
# Create a potion flask with the robust glass
# Combine both super antifire potions (3) to make 1 super antifire flask (6)
open the engraved sarcophagus in the final room of Pyramid Plunder.

kill a desert strykewyrm while wearing a full slayer helmet and wielding an ancient staff. 

A player may use a full slayer helmet or any upgraded variants, as well as any recoloured version of those, but not a normal slayer helmet. If the player has their slayer helmet on the slayer helmet stand at the Slayer Lodge, it must be removed and worn for the kill to count. The staff cannot be borrowed. Any equipment can be used during the fight, but in order to complete the achievement, the staff and helmet must be equipped when the final blow is dealt and the monster is killed. When all requirements are met, a player does not need a slayer task to kill a strykewyrm. Using a familiar will draw the strykewyrm's attention and cause it to stop fighting, yielding the message "It's not after you..."

plant the dominion marker (stage 4) in the Desert.
This marker can be unlocked after completing all achievements from the Dominion Tower, excluding the Rumble Mode achievements.

use a crater to convert a memory of tier 2 or higher to energy in the starting room of a Dungeoneering floor.

Memories can be gathered from the same type of wisp, which are randomly found in dungeons. A crater to convert memories is located in the start room. If necessary, boosts may be used.

The crater must be configured to convert memories to energy. Converting memories to XP will not work.

pass the guards guarding the Wilderness entrance at Daemonheim.

While doing this achievement make sure you're not currently opted in to PvP.

switch to another bind loadout which requires the player to have at least two pieces of bound equipment.

Bound items can be found by selecting the "bind" option on the Smuggler which can be found in the starting room of a Dungeoneering floor. Here the player can create different bind loadouts.

To complete the achievement the player has to either load a different bind loadout or change their current binds and then load their loadout by pressing the arrow on the right side.

Although level 20 Dungeoneering is listed as a requirement for this achievement, it can be completed from level 1 Dungeoneering by using an off-hand item as a second bound item as both an off-hand and main-hand item can be bound from level 1 Dungeoneering.

equip a full set of protoleather armour, salve equipment, or novite equipment (helm, body, legs, boots and gloves) inside a Dungeoneering floor.

The armour can be bought from the Smuggler in the starting room of the dungeon or created by the player. The player can also simply equip the armour made for the Setting Up achievement.

use a combat familiar to help fight a boss using their standard attacks inside a Dungeoneering floor. A combat familiar could be either a bloodrager, a deathslinger or a stormbringer.

To create a familiar pouch the player needs any type of charm and a secondary item depending on which familiar they are creating. For example a cub bloodrager pouch is made with a gold charm and a novite ore.
use a ring of kinship on a player-made fire inside a Dungeoneering floor.

For non-ironman:

Complete a Dungeoneering floor in a team of more than 1. A Dungeoneering party simulator does not work.

For ironman:

Complete a medium Dungeoneering floor in high complexity mode. A large Dungeoneering floor does not work.

* All players: feed a teammate some food to heal them inside a Dungeoneering floor.

* Ironmen only: attempt to feed a Dungeoneering familiar.

make a full suit of tier 1 armour (helm, body, legs, boots, and gloves) inside a dungeoneering floor.

Making a full set of protoleather armour requires level 9 Crafting and 12 protomastyx hide, while making a full set of Salve equipment requires level 8 Crafting and 12 salve cloth. An alternative would be to make a full set of novite equipment which requires level 7 Smithing and 10 novite bars (making a novite chainbody instead of a platebody). If necessary, an artisan's potion may be used to boost the related skills.

For regular accounts, ironman accounts, hardcore ironman accounts, and regular group ironman accounts:

Complete a Sinkhole. Sinkholes can be started by talking to Talsar in the Daemonheim camp.

For competitive group ironman:

Locate a Sinkhole. Sinkholes can be located by talking to Talsar in the Daemonheim camp.
reset their current floor progress. It is recommended to complete all available Dungeoneering floors before resetting the floor progress.

complete a Fremennik Saga (abridged or unabridged) after talking to Skaldrun.

Before the player can start these sagas, they have to rescue Skaldrun from the Frozen floors first. These floors can be found at Dungeoneering floors 1-11.
complete a solo Dungeoneering floor.

defeat the boss on Dungeoneering floor 1, on their own.

This achievement can be completed at any complexity, although it is easiest to complete on low complexity.
complete a solo Dungeoneering floor without dying.

attempt to pick-lock the door east of the gem stall in Ardougne Market which is the southern house on the east side of the marketplace. Right click on the door and select "Pick-lock". The attempt does not need to be successful for the achievement to be completed.

complete a high complexity solo floor in under 6 minutes. This is easiest on a small Dungeoneering floor.

It is advised to avoid killing creatures, unless they are in a room that has a guardian door.

unlock a Thieving chest with a skill requirement of at least inside a Dungeoneering floor.

Within a high complexity floor, every room, other than the boss and starting room may contain at least one Thieving chest.

to boost their Magic level with a self-made tier 2+ potion (from seed). The potion can only be made in a Dungeoneering floor with high complexity.

To make the potion the player will need to grow grimy wormwood leaf or grimy winter's grip and get void dust which can be bought from the Smuggler or obtained from killing creatures. If the herbs are not self grown it will not complete the achievement. Simply planting the seed and then using a herb that has been dropped also unlocks the achievement.

gain the Beast Mode title on a high complexity solo Dungeoneering floor. It is easiest to do this on a small floor.

To earn the Beast Mode title, all resources and monsters that are in the rooms necessary to reach the boss must be depleted/killed. Boosts can be used if necessary.

Resources that count towards getting the Beast Mode title include:
* Fish (Fishing)
* Branches (Woodcutting)
* Textiles (Farming)
* Wisps (Divination)
** You only need to activate each wisp, and can safely allow them to deplete without harvesting.
* Ores (Mining)
* Mastices (Fletching + Hunter)

Depleting textiles, wisps and mastices is not necessary for getting the achievement as a non-member.

use either a smithing autoheater, gem bag, herbicide, bonecrusher, or charming imp, which can all be bought from the Daemonheim Rewards shop with dungeoneering tokens.

The cheapest option is the gem bag, which costs 2,000 tokens and requires level 25 Crafting. Emptying a gem bag will also complete the achievement.

The herbicide bought from the Farmers' Market will also work but require completing the player-owned farm tutorial and 10,000 beans.

kill Rammernaut without getting charged, or make him stun himself. Rammernaut can be found on Furnished Floors 18–29.

It is recommended to use magic or range since this allows the player to hug the wall which tends to cause Rammernaut to trip more frequently. It is recommended to do this achievement on low complexity or in free-to-play for a lower levelled Rammernaut.
create a portent of passage V or above. This must be done on high complexity, as this will unlock Divination on the Dungeoneering floors.

place down a self-made spinebeam trap. It is not required to catch a bovimastyx, only to place down the trap.

The trap can be made by fletching spinebeam branches into a trap. The branches can be obtained from cutting a spinebeam tree which requires level 40 Woodcutting, or they can also be bought from the Smuggler, or received as a drop from killing creatures.

teleport out of a boss room boss using a self-made gatestone, so the group gatestone will not work.

A gatestone is made via the Create Gatestone spell, which requires 3 cosmic runes. Boosts may be used, if necessary.

Teleporting after a boss has been killed will also complete the achievement. The achievement can not be completed on Dungeoneering floors with a Luminescent icefiend boss, as it is not possible to teleport out of the boss room with this boss.

For regular accounts, ironman accounts, hardcore ironman accounts, and regular group ironman accounts:

Hand in a total of 20 items in a single sinkhole. 
Handing in items after their objective has been met will not count, and thus not complete the achievement.

For ironman accounts, hardcore ironman accounts, regular group ironman accounts, and competitive group ironman accounts:

Enter the 6 resource dungeons with an entry requirement equal to or less than level 35 Dungeoneering within 6 minutes.

Ironman mode accounts can complete either objective, but it is not possible for competitive group ironman mode accounts to enter sinkholes.

sacrifice frost dragon bones from a dragon they killed themself on a prayer altar in a solo Dungeoneering floor. Frost dragons can only be encountered on Frozen floors 1-11.

It is recommended to do medium or large floors to find them, as frost dragons are very rare. This also gives more chance on finding a prayer altar. It appears that frost dragons are very rare in solo dungeons for players below level 100 combat, and are rare in free-to-play regardless of combat level. They appear to be easier to find in solo dungeons when players are above level 100 combat, and if they are a member. 

If members cannot find a prayer altar, they have the option to build the altar at the starting room hotspot with 5 bovistrangler branches and 5 zephyrium bar, which requires level 75 Construction (boostable).

complete a solo furnished floor on any complexity.

Furnished floors can be found on Dungeoneering floors 18-29.

build a prayer altar in the starting room by right clicking the group gatestone portal and choosing the option 'replace', and then filling up their prayer points from it. A boost may be used if necessary to build the altar.

To build the altar a total of 5 Bovistrangler branches and 5 Zephyrium bars are required.

make a bouldabass & edicap potato from the raw ingredients and eat it during a boss fight inside a Dungeoneering floor.

Boosts may be used to make the stuffed potato if necessary. If using boosts, planting the edicap mushroom seed and harvesting it both require a boost.

# Cook Raw cave potato
# Mix Baked cave potato with Bouldabass
# Mix Bouldabass potato with Edicap mushroom
# Eat in boss battle

use the Rapid Renewal prayer for 1 minute while in a Dungeoneering floor.

The prayer must first be unlocked, costing 38,000 Dungeoneering tokens. It is recommended to have at least 110 prayer points, as there is no prayer gear inside the dungeon. It is possible to get the achievement by activating the prayer, disabling it, and re-activating it a little under a minute later until players achieve it.

have Bal'lak the Pummeller walk onto his own rifts in a solo Dungeoneering floor.

Bal'lak the Pummeller can be found on Abandoned Floors 33–35.

The achievement will not trigger unless Bal'lak has built up his defence beforehand. This requires that he be attacked first.

craft some law runes inside a Dungeoneering floor.

A naturalist's potion may be used to boost Runecrafting if necessary.

fully complete a solo Occult floor which can be found on Dungeoneering floor 36-47.

To complete the entire floor the player must uncover all rooms.

harvest memories from a tier 8 (or higher) spring inside a Dungeoneering floor.

Only Lustrous springs and above will count. Either a gatherer's potion or a strong gatherer's potion maybe used to boost if necessary.

imbue a Catalytic wand on a Runecrafting altar inside a Dungeoneering floor. A boost may be used if necessary.

The wand can be made from spinebeam branches with level 48 Fletching, which can be bought from the Smuggler, gathered through cutting a Spinebeam tree or obtained from killing creatures.

successfully cook 1 of each type of fish inside a Dungeoneering floor. A naturalist's potion or a strong naturalist's potion may be used to boost Cooking if necessary. Only fish cooked on members' worlds count for this achievement; fish cooked on free worlds will not be marked.

kill the Warped gulega boss without getting hit by its 1 lifepoint attack in a solo Dungeoneering floor.

Warped gulega can be found on Warped floors 48–60.

wear 4 bound items at once.

It is not possible to complete this achievement by binding a main hand weapon along with any off-hand weapon, and wielding them both.

It is, however, possible to complete this achievement by binding a main hand weapon with a shield and wielding them both.

create and use a portent of restoration IX or higher by either using 50 brilliant energy and 1 blue crab or 60 radiant energy and 1 cave moray.

Divination may be boosted by using a gatherer's potion or a strong gatherer's potion if necessary.

Keep in mind that to activate the portent you will need to be hit by a creature's attack and reduced from above 50% health to below 50%. It doesn't have to be one-hit from 100% and environmental damage rarely works.
use the spirit tree to the north-east of the Grand Exchange.

light a bullseye lantern within the Chemist's House in Rimmington.

The lantern only needs to be lit within the premises, it does not have to be constructed there. Sapphire and emerald lanterns also work.

summon a cat or kitten in the sandy patch in Port Sarim next to Felkrash and The Face.

Any kind of cat or kitten, except clockwork cats, will work. Players must stand in the centre of the sandy circle, 3 tiles north of the full fishing net and summon/drop their cat from their inventory. The full fishing net is located at the north-east corner of the fishing shop.

mine from the concentrated gold deposits located in the Living Rock Caverns.

The living rock creatures are aggressive, but can be pacified by wearing the magic golem outfit or fury shark outfit.

Having Grace of the Elves or a similar Sign of the Porter effect enabled, you may not be able to earn the achievement.
use the small obelisk near Rellekka's main southern gate. This can be done with full summoning points.

use the fairy ring network to teleport to fairy ring to appear on a mountaintop, near the windswept tree.

Dramen staff or lunar staff is required, unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

kill a mithril dragon, which are found in the Ancient Cavern.

High combat levels are strongly recommended. The mithril dragon is weak to earth spells and bane ammunition.

A strategy for low-level players is to tag the dragon and then have a higher-level friend finish it off.

pick up five pieces of seaweed on Karamja.

Seaweed can be found along the coast of Karamja, such as west of Tai Bwo Wannai. Dropping the same piece of seaweed and picking it up again counts as multiple pieces being picked up. You do not even have to find any spawn - you can withdraw 1 seaweed from a bank, drop it anywhere in Karamja, pick it up, repeat 5 times.

cross over the stepping stones found near the moss giants in Brimhaven Dungeon.

To access the dungeon, players must pay Saniboch . The steps can be found by heading west as far as possible then heading south.

craft at least 56 nature runes simultaneously without using runecrafting pouches or familiars. Though not stated, players cannot bring essence that is stored in any of the ethereal outfits while completing this achievement, but the outfit may be worn as long as it is empty.

The runes must be crafted at the nature altar, regardless of whether it is accessed via the ruins in Karamja, the Abyss, or the Great Orb Project.

Runes crafted in Daemonheim will not count.

The achievement can be completed from 44 Runecrafting by drinking a powerburst of sorcery, dropping it, and obtaining a full backpack of pure essence using a friend, or non-abyssal Beast of Burden to carry the potion. Catalytic anima stones can also be used to complete this achievement from 44 Runecrafting.

earn at least 75 Slayer points from a single task from Lapalok.

Lapalok will replace Duradel as a Slayer Master at Shilo Village during and after While Guthix Sleeps. Lapalok will only reward 75 or more points if the player completes their 10th, 50th, or 100th task with him in a row without resetting at Spria and if Smoking Kills is completed (10th task only). The fastest way to complete this achievement is by doing 1st–9th tasks at a lower slayer master like Jacquelyn and picking up the 10th task from Lapalok.
enter the courtyard of Draynor Manor.
enter Al Kharid via its western gate.
have a clay ring blessed by Father Aereck in Lumbridge Church.

craft at least 100 water runes at once without using (or even carrying in their backpack) an explorer's ring, runecrafting pouches, or Summoning familiars.

Despite the stated 57 Runecrafting requirement, members with as low as level 19 Runecrafting can use elemental anima stones to complete this achievement. Without the elemental anima stones, 57 Runecrafting is required by carrying at least 25 essence.

take an easy companion through an easy route of Temple Trekking.

Simply choose an easy companion at the Temple Trekking start point, and guide them through an easy route. Players can continue if they teleported out before and still get the achievement done. Sometimes it won't count unless the continue-easy path button was clicked.
kill an experiment under Fenkenstrain's Castle. Go to the graveyard south-east of Fenkenstrain's Castle. Push the grave furthest from the castle to enter the area below the castle.

give five locals a glass of cider or mature cider in the Forester's Arms in Seers' Village.

Cider may be bought at the The Esoterican Arms (located underground in Miscellania after the Royal Trouble quest) or from the Grand Exchange. It may also be created through Brewing at the Laughing Miner Pub in Keldagrim, The Green Ghost in Port Phasmatys, or the Burnt Lobster Tavern in Wendlewick.

The cider may be used on the same person five times, without having to run around.

enter through the gates of the Arandar Pass while wearing only a full set of mourner gear.

Only the mourner gear must be worn with all other equipment slots empty. Overrides and (active) auras are allowed to be worn on this achievement. After completing the Plague's End quest, the mourner gear can be re-obtained in a chest from the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne. The chest is in the room which was previously where the head mourner was. Using the Sixth-Age circuit's teleport to the World Gate option will bring the player a few steps away from the gate.

get Gwir in Lletya to remind the player about their previous adventures in the elven lands. Gwir is the scribe who can be found north of the bank in Lletya.

If the player has not previously told Gwir about their adventures, then players will need to go through the dialogue first and then ask about their previous adventures.

kill a shadow in the Temple of Light with a shadow spell. Earth runes and either death runes or blood runes, as well as a magic weapon are required to complete this achievement.

Shadow spells are one of five types of Ancient Magicks combat spells. An ability will not work; the runes must be spent to cast the spell and kill the shadow with a regular auto-attack to get credit for the achievement.

The shadows in Prifddinas do not work for this achievement.
navigate the Underground Pass, using the thieving shortcuts and talking to Klank on the way through about his gauntlets.

teleport to the fairy ring with code in the Poison Waste.

The player will require a Lunar staff or dramen staff, unless A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed.

kill a disciple of Iban while using Iban's staff.

If the player no longer has Iban's staff after the quest, then a disciple of Iban must be killed in order to receive a broken Iban's staff. The broken staff can be repaired by the dark mage (east of the Underground Pass entrance in West Ardougne) for 200,000 coins. If the player has completed the Mourning's End Part II, the death altar can be used to quickly return to the end of the Underground Pass. Teleport to the death altar and enter the tunnel on the west wall. Run all the way north and enter the cave stairs.

The staff only needs to be equipped when the disciple dies, it does not have to be used to kill the disciple. Attacking with Iban's staff can be done by casting a regular spell, or by using the Weapon Special Attack ability located in the Constitution book.
attempt to pass a leaf trap in the Isafdar forest. The attempt does not need to be successful.
mine limestone at the Arandar Pass mine, just south-east of Prifddinas.

kill a warped terrorbird or tortoise in the Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon. A crystal chime is required to kill the warped creatures, the one on the tool belt works.

The spirit tree Incomitatus is closest to access the dungeon. Players can also run west from Castle Wars, but will need a crossbow and a mithril grapple, or alternatively an enhanced grappling hook on the tool belt, to cross a gap to reach the dungeon. The three warped terrorbirds killed during The Path of Glouphrie quest do not count for this achievement.

have Eluned or Ilfeen recharge a crystal teleport seed in the Isafdar forest.

Right-clicking Eluned to recharge does complete the achievement. Selecting the seed and using it on Eluned does not complete the achievement. Recharging a crystal with Ilfeen will also work, but Eluned in Prifddinas will not. Selecting the seed and using it on Ilfeen does work.

The location of Ilfeen is dependent on progress in The Prisoner of Glouphrie quest, if it is completed then one needs to visit Ilfeen in Lletya. 

Contacting Islwyn through the NPC Contact spell no longer works for the achievement, but this method can be used to recharge the seed.
use the Home Teleport spell to teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone.

equip a Tyras helm inside the Tyras Camp.

A Tyras helm can be bought at any Trader Crewmember. There is one in Port Tyras. It will only trigger if you equip it while inside the camp, not wearing it into the camp.
find out about the history of the Wilderness from Vala.
enter the Wilderness by any means.
view the bank in the Wilderness via one of the cape merchants.
view the recent Wilderness kills on the death list noticeboard in Edgeville, just west of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange.
enter the Chaos Tunnels from an entrance in the Wilderness. There is an entrance over the wall; a short distance north of the Edgeville lodestone.

reach a score of 10 using the strange switches in the Wilderness. The switches are located north of Fort Forinthry, west of the entrance to Daemonheim from the Wilderness, and east of the Chaos Temple. It is recommended to bring food and armour or complete in free-to-play worlds due to the bound skeletons and fetid zombies roaming the area. They can be partially avoided by taking a circular path around the east instead of taking a straight path between the levers.
teleport to the lodestone in the Wilderness. The Wilderness lodestone must be activated to complete this achievement.

purchase a halberd from the Tyras Camp, then use it to kill an elf warrior in the Elf Camp south of Prifddinas.

The Quartermaster in the south-eastern corner of the Tyras Camp sells the halberds. Any type of halberd will suffice, but a higher-tiered type is recommended for a faster kill. The Elf Camp can be accessed easily by heading all the way south of the Prifddinas lodestone, passing the guards, and heading west through the dense forest. The halberd which was bought at the Tyras Camp does not need to be used for the killing part, players could just buy a bronze halberd and use any weapon to kill the elf, as long as the last hit is dealt with a halberd. The crystal halberd and its attuned version do not work.

create a yew longbow from scratch in Tirannwn. Yew trees in the Isafdar forest and in Prifddinas work. This includes yew trees grown by the player in Prifddinas. Flax can be picked either south of Lletya bank or in the Cadarn district of Prifddinas. Spinning wheels are located in the Lletya Seamstress' shop and in the eastern side of the Cadarn district in Prifddinas. Using the Tirannwn lodestone teleport then heading west through the dense forest is the quickest way to access yew trees.
exit Tirannwn and navigate through the Galarpos Mountains. Completion of the quest The Prisoner of Glouphrie is required.

make harralander tar in the Poison Waste using swamp tar sourced in Tirannwn.

Buy 15 swamp tar from the Lletya General Store after completing the easy achievement set; the Tirannwn quiver 1 must be claimed before being able to finish this achievement. Make the tar on the first island one can hop to, past the magic trees south of Lletya's entrance, or use the island accessed through the fairy ring network, code . The tar must be made on an island in the Poison Waste. If failing the first time, more swamp tar can be obtained from the Grand Exchange, or wait until the store's stock has replenished as obtaining it from Lletya the first time was recorded as progress.

enter the Temple of Light using a crystal teleport seed or attuned crystal teleport seed.

The ability to teleport to the Temple of Light is added by talking to Eluned after the Within the Light quest with a crystal teleport seed of 8 charges in the player's inventory. Although she will recharge the teleport seed at any of her locations, she only gives the added teleport option if spoken to in one of her two locations in Isafdar. These are east of the Tyras Camp and west of Lletya. The Temple of Light teleport will not be added when speaking to Eluned in Prifddinas, you must find her in the forest. Players can quickly get to Eluned by using the teleport option on the Tirannwn quiver 1.

If The Light Within is already completed, then speak with Islwyn in the Ithell Clan district of Prifddinas.

trap a pawya in Tirannwn using a papaya that was harvested by the player from a player grown papaya tree at the Lletya or Prifddinas fruit tree patch.

The optional protection by the elven farmer Amaethwr for a papaya tree requires 10 pineapples as a payment. If the farmer is not paid to protect the patch then it is possible the patch could be diseased. It is also possible to fail to catch a pawya, so multiple papayas may be required. A convenient Hunter area with both pawyas and grenwalls is located west of the Tirannwn lodestone, past the dense forest obstacle.

create death runes from at least 20 pure essences whilst wearing a death tiara at the death altar.

Alternatively, an omni-tiara may be used instead of the death tiara. Wearing a wicked hood that has been fed a death talisman will work as a substitute for completing the achievement. An ethereal hood will not count as a death tiara, however it can still be used as a substitute for the wicked hood. There needs to be 20 pure essences in the backpack. Having pure essence only in essence pouches will not work. The pure essence withdrawn from a pouch will work, but the pure essence needs to be withdrawn by emptying the pouch, not by automatically crafting the contents of the pouch.

bank a raw shark fished in Tirannwn using the Elf Camp deposit chest.

A single shark fishing spot is found in the north-west corner of the Camp. The deposit chest is unlocked after completing Deadliest Catch. The shark must be raw. Cooked and burnt sharks do not count. If you have the Bait and Switch relic active, you can bring a raw shark to deposit in place of the cooked shark that you catch. Raw Great White Sharks do count.

create a stranger plant pouch at the obelisk near the Well of Voyage which requires 1 crimson charm, 1 bagged plant 1, 128 spirit shards, and a pouch.

If the Fang of Mohegan is owned, the teleport is useful to teleport directly to the obelisk. Create the pouch at the obelisk located in the cave north of Lletya marked as a Summoning and dungeon entrance icon on the (mini) map.

use pawya meat in a grenwall trap. The pawya meat needs to be used on a box trap in a Hunter area in Isafdar. A grenwall does not need to be caught for the achievement to complete.

A convenient Hunter area with both pawyas and grenwalls is located west of the Tirannwn lodestone, past the dense forest obstacle. It may be faster to trap the pawya at the magic trees (exit Lletya and head south), since there are no predatory grenwalls to kill them. The players need papaya fruit as a bait to trap the pawya.

Any Hunter area outside Isafdar, such as the Gorajo resource dungeon and Nyriki's private hunting grounds, will not work.

purchase a Guthix staff, Zamorak staff, or Saradomin staff from the chamber guardian in the Mage Arena, located in the deep Wilderness. Each staff costs 80,000 coins.

The Mage Arena minigame must be completed before entering the sparkling pool.

Players can use High Alchemy on the staff to recuperate 48,000 back, leading to a net loss of only 32,000.
create an anchovy pizza from scratch in the Wilderness Bandit Camp and give it to Fat Tony.

loot a chest in the magic axe hut in the deep Wilderness which requires a lockpick. Make sure to right click the door to pick lock it, and to right click the chests to disable the traps before opening them.

Players can use the Edgeville teleport lever or Ardougne teleport lever and travel north-east to get there.

open the muddy chest in the Lava Maze with a muddy key.

Players can use the teleport of a Lava Titan for quick access to the Lava Maze. Players may need a knife or sharp weapon to cut through the spider webs. Players may buy the key from the Grand Exchange, kill chaos dwarves for it, or receive it as loot from the magic axe hut chests.
complete a full lap of the Wilderness Agility Course. The Agility level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.

pickpocket a rogue in Rogues' Castle in the deep Wilderness.

Rogue Enforcers and Rogue Captains work too.

create a luck potion from scratch whilst in the Wilderness.

# Pick a grimy bloodweed from the bloodweed plant grown from bloodweed seed in the Wilderness herb patch.
# Clean the herb and add it to a vial of water.
# Cut an uncut dragonstone and grind it into dust.
# Add the crushed dragonstone to the bloodweed potion (unfinished) potion.

The achievement does not start until the grimy bloodweed has been collected and cleaned and must be done in the order listed. Despite saying it can be boosted, it cannot be boosted.

Players may want to save a bloodweed for the What Potion? hard achievement and one for the Come At Me, Bro! elite achievement, although one only needs to have to pick the herb and mix the (unfinished) potion once to tick it off in all three achievements.

farm and mix the ingredients for a prayer renewal potion entirely in Morytania.

# Fellstalk seed (level 91 Farming) requires planting and harvesting in the herb patch to the west of Port Phasmatys.
# Morchella mushroom spores (level 74 Farming) requires planting and harvesting in the mushroom patch to the east of Paterdomus.
# Finally, mix a clean fellstalk and a morchella mushroom into a vial of water.

Players must have the correct farming level to plant and harvest; otherwise, the partial achievement progress will not register.

A pork pie can be used at level 86 to achieve a +5 Farming boost, and spicy stews can be used for +6 Herblore boost.
string a magic shortbow in the Seers' Village bank by adding a bowstring to a magic shortbow (u).

enter the Seers' Village courthouse with the Piety prayer turned on.

The Seers' Village courthouse is located south of the bank. Entering the courthouse and then turning on Piety will not work, players must first enable Piety and then walk in.

cast High Level Alchemy on a magic shortbow in Seers' Village bank.

It is easier to use High Level Alchemy on the bow that was made for the achievement, The Short of It, rather than to buy another one.

It is also possible to use explorer's ring 4, a radiant alchemist's amulet, or a legendary pet's ability for this achievement.

make an extreme ranging potion from scratch and drink it within the Ranging Guild.

Each step needs to be completed within the area. Bring the ingredients for a super ranging potion (ingredients can be brought in from outside the area), make it inside the Ranging Guild, add the five grenwall spikes, and finally drink one dose. The achievement will be updated in the achievement as steps are completed. Boosts can be used but must remain when drinking the potion.

bake an admiral pie from scratch within the Seers' Village and Catherby area.

# Fish raw salmon (south west of Sinclair Mansion, bring feathers for lure fishing) and raw tuna (east of Catherby docks, cage/harpoon fishing spot) and cook them.
# Farm a raw potato. A potato can be farmed in Catherby to complete the achievement. Potato seeds require 40 minutes to harvest (you can use Supreme growth potion (sundry) to speed up the process). Taking a potato from the Sinclair Mansion vegetable patch will not work. Stealing a potato from the Vegetable Stalls in Catherby will not work.
# Make pastry dough and use it on a pie dish to create a pie shell. (If not buying on GE, pie dish and bucket of water spawn in the house north of the Catherby bank. A pot can be bought from the grocery store, Arhein's Store, on the Catherby docks, and it can be filled at the Mill Road Mill or in the kitchen (flour barrel) of the Sinclair Mansion.) 
# Make raw admiral pie. Add a cooked salmon and cooked tuna to the pie shell. Then add a raw potato that has been harvested from a patch in Catherby.
# Bake the raw admiral pie on a cooking range in Catherby or Seers' Village. This step cannot be done until all the preceding steps have been completed.

It is possible to go to the achievement in the interface to see whether a step has been counted. All of the steps mentioned in the achievements description must be completed inside the area. The only items which are allowed to be brought from elsewhere are potato seeds, pot of flour, some water, a pie dish and the tools to fish with. The water and pie dish can be found in the house with the cooking range, north of the bank in Catherby. The salmon can only be caught in the lake north of Seers' Village bank, make sure you do not have Rainbow Fish selected for featherless fly fishing by going into the Settings → Gameplay → Skills and experience → Construction → Aquarium settings → Featherless Fly fishing. The tuna can be harpooned at the Catherby shore fishing spots. A potato must be farmed in Catherby to complete the achievement. Players can fetch flour out of Sinclair Mansion if they have none and don't want to leave the area, they will need an empty pot to put it in.

The Bake Pie spell will not work and a range must be used.

cleanse the corrupted Seren Stone with at least one cleansing crystal.

This requires purchase of a cleansing crystal for ; alternatively the cleansing crystal can rarely be received from pickpocketing Hefin workers, or when cutting crystal trees with a crystal hatchet.
bring bacon mound, bread, and a chocolate bar to Seren, who is located upstairs in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas, and use one of the items on Seren.
play and retune each of the four harps in the Ithell Harmonium.

defeat an Iorwerth scout or Iorwerth guard while under the influence of the prayer altar in the mansion in the Iorwerth Clan district in Prifddinas by praying at that altar.

Leaving the room will nullify the progress of completing this achievement.

wear a bracelet of clay while mining soft clay in the Ithell Clan district of Prifddinas.

A bracelet of clay can be bought from the Grand Exchange for.

swap to the Ancient Magicks spellbook at the elven grimoire in the Cadarn Clan district and then defeat a Cadarn magus or Cadarn ranger. Abilities are allowed and the elf does not need to be killed with Magic.

complete a slayer assignment that was assigned by Morvran and has been both preferred and extended.

The assigned task does not have to be on the preferred list prior to assignment. A task can be received (or forced by using a monster specific slayer mask/helm), then preferred by spending 100 slayer points. This will also extend the assignment. To access preferred assignment and extension on the assignment, right click Morvran for rewards and select the tab for assignments.

use the dance emote in Daffyd's house in the Amlodd Clan district of Prifddinas after 10 or more different types of implings have been caught.

The Impetuous Impulses minigame has a large variety of implings to catch, so it's an ideal location for catching 10 different kinds of implings for this achievement. It is also possible to obtain implings (in a jar) from Motherlode Maw or in the Gorajo resource dungeon.

take a shortcut on the Hefin Agility Course in Prifddinas.

A green message will appear in the chatbox when the shortcut is available.

complete the Hefin Agility Course with a light creature familiar summoned and pet overrides turned off. The Summoning level cannot be boosted.

There is currently a bug that prevents players from getting credit for the achievement if they completed the course with a Hefin course multiplier in the backpack. Complete the course again without any multipliers in the backpack to complete the achievement. Velocity activating on any obstacle will also prevent players from getting credit for the achievement. 

Players will still get the achievement if they summon the familiar right before the final obstacle, merging with the light creature.

create a Elemental Titan scroll (Titan's Constitution) when the Amlodd Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren. Either a moss titan pouch, ice titan pouch, or fire titan pouch is required to make this scroll and converting the pouch into scrolls needs to be done at the obelisk in the Amlodd Clan district in order to complete this achievement. No other obelisk will work.

use a crystal bow or attuned crystal bow to damage either a Cadarn magus or Cadarn ranger with an auto-attack when the Cadarn Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren. Using abilities to damage a Cadarn warrior will not count for this achievement. Having arrows or arrows in a quiver equipped or in the backpack may prevent the achievement from unlocking.

cut a magic log in the Crwys Clan district in Prifddinas when the Crwys Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren.

The magic trees are in the four corners of the bridge area between the Crwys Clan district and the Cadarn Clan district.
complete one lap of the Hefin Agility Course successfully when the Hefin Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren.

use a crystal dagger or its off-hand version to damage an Iorwerth guard or Iorwerth scout while the Iorwerth Voice of Seren is active.

Alternatively an attuned crystal dagger and its off-hand version work as well. The Iorwerth warrior must be attacked with an auto-attack, not an ability for the achievement to be completed. The elf must be inside the Iorwerth Clan district, the main streets do not count.

craft a perfect juju farming potion by using a juju farming potion (3) with harmony moss which was harvested by the player when the Meilyr Clan district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren. Both steps need to be completed while the Voice of Seren is active there. In addition, the potion must be mixed while the player is in the Meilyr district; the achievement will not be completed if the potion is mixed elsewhere.

mine an adamantite rock or runite rock at the Trahaearn Clan district when that district is illuminated by the Voice of Seren.

Do not wear a sign of the porter, the auto banking feature will prevent the game from registering the mined ore and because of that the achievement cannot be completed.

exchange a familiar pouch for spirit shards with Lord Amlodd.

The player needs to have a Summoning level higher than the level that is required to create the pouch, see Bogrog for the exact details.

Swapping scrolls also work. It is not known if this is a bug.

find and speak to the elf lords and ladies from each of the eight Elven Clans inside the walls of Prifddinas until the first chat options appear. They can be found in their respective clan districts. A crystal teleport seed, an attuned crystal teleport seed, or the Master camouflage outfit can be used to teleport to each district to speed things up.

play a non-reward game of Rush of Blood.

An easy way to finish this achievement is to equip no items, begin a trial run, and let the monsters kill the player. Exiting the dungeon while the timer is running will not count.
unfurl a flag in the Max Guild garden or Jump For Joy if all flags are already unfurled.

use the advanced cliffside scramble shortcut while navigating through the Arandar Pass.

Head out the eastern entrance of Prifddinas and follow the path until one comes to a fork in the road. Some Agility shortcut icons appear on the minimap; follow the path south until the third shortcut icon is found. Use the shortcut and the achievement will be completed.
talk to the gorajo hoardstalker while under the influence of a perfect juju dungeoneering potion.

clear wave 15 of the Rush of Blood Distraction and Diversion on either the gold or platinum difficulty. Wave 15 must be completed, which means that wave 16 needs to start before the timer runs out to complete this achievement. The run can be done as a trial or a reward run.

chop a log from an elder tree which they have grown in the elder tree patch in Prifddinas, then fletch it into an elder shortbow (unstrung). The bow does not need to be strung to complete the achievement.
pickpocket a Trahaearn worker while wearing the Trahaearn exoskeleton set.

visit Seren in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas, and bow or curtsy whilst wearing the Crest of Seren override. Do not confuse the Crest of Seren override with Seren's symbol or with the Crest of Seren from the Heart of Gielinor.

make a level 90 milestone cape using a loom in Prifddinas which requires 9 balls of wool.

The loom can be found in the eastern Cadarn Clan district. Making a level 90 milestone cape requires all skills to be at least level 90. Invention does not count towards this achievement as it is an elite skill. You cannot use skill boosts to make the cape.

sing an attuned crystal weapon from an attuned crystal weapon seed in the Ithell Clan district of Prifddinas which requires at least 1,000 harmonic dust in addition to the seed.

Lady Ithell gives one free attuned crystal weapon seed to a player as long as a player does not own one or any attuned crystal weapon and if the player has not dropped anything in the past 10 minutes. This includes the player's inventory, bank and Lady Ithell's storage. Players may revert existing attuned crystal weapons and sing them into a weapon again. If players choose to destroy the seed once received from Lady Ithell, they can receive another one the following week, but only while the achievement has not been completed yet. The player must have the required skills for Lady Ithell to offer the free seed (not boostable). Singing an attuned crystal armour seed will also complete the achievement, and you will not be able to claim the weapon seed if this is done beforehand.
smith 10 unfeathered bane bolts (requires 1 bane bar) and feather them by adding 10 feathers. Both steps must be performed within Varrock.

defeat a tormented wraith which requires the use of Jennica's ring and a set of black equipment consisting of an item to fill the head, torso, legs, main hand, and off-hand equipment slots.

Only black equipment will damage the Wraith. Armour that can be worn includes the elite black armour set and Black Knight captain's armour. However, only base sets without trim seem to work. Wearing trimmed black armour will cause the player to receive the message "You find yourself unable to attack the wraith."

Head to the centre of the Dark Warriors' Fortress near 15 Wilderness. Once in the centre of the fortress near the hanging skeleton, use the "operate" function on Jennica's ring to enter the Spirit Realm.

complete one of Erskine's Wilderness Slayer contracts.

It is recommended to complete a minimum requirement Slayer contract (and claim the reward) such as hellhounds or greater demons, as less risk is needed and it is very fast to complete.

defeat the King Black Dragon with the Wilderness entrance's buff, dealing the most damage.

The entrance buff, a 10% damage boost, can be acquired by using the artefact in the Lava Maze Dungeon to enter the lair. The cape merchant Darren is located on the surface, near the ladder to the artefact, and he can be used as a nearby banking location.

activate and teleport from each of the Wilderness obelisks.

This might take a while due to the randomness of the obelisks. Alternatively, players could ask a friend who has done the hard set of achievements to set the teleport to each obelisk. This does not have be completed while being opted into PvP.

defeat the Chaos Elemental and deal the most damage. This means that if more than one player is fighting the Chaos Elemental, only the player who deals the most damage is eligible for completing the achievement upon defeating it.
harvest a limpwurt root from the farming patch in the Western Ruins in the Wilderness.

charge an unpowered orb at the Obelisk of Air.

This achievement requires at least 1 unpowered orb, 30 air runes, and 3 cosmic runes. Players will need to be on the standard spell book to access the Charge Air Orb spell.

This Magic level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.

make a camouflage potion whilst in the Wilderness from scratch.

# Plant a bloodweed seed in the Wilderness herb patch.
# Collect a grimy bloodweed from Wilderness herb patch.
# Clean the bloodweed.
# Add the bloodweed to a vial of water.
# Add a black salamander to the bloodweed potion (unf) resulting in a camouflage potion.

The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted.

loot warband supplies from a Wilderness Warbands camp. PvP needed to be toggled on to be able to interact with Warbands.

Players of all levels could attack the player while they were carrying the supplies. Wilderness Warbands only happened once every 7 hours.

Ironman Mode players only needed to attempt to loot a camp to complete the achievement. PvP had to be enabled to attempt to loot and complete the achievement.

create an aggression potion from scratch whilst in the Wilderness. The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted - the potion will be created, but the achievement will not be completed.

# Plant and harvest a grimy bloodweed.
# Clean the herb.
# Put the herb into a vial of water.
# Add a heap of searing ashes to create the aggression potion.

capture a charming moth.

The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted. While boosts normally work for catching moths, they will not count for the achievement.

While the game does not specify, the achievement will only complete if the charming moth is caught without a butterfly net.

defeat a lava strykewyrm in the Wilderness.

See here for its mechanics. Do not scatter the searing ashes, as they are needed to complete the elite achievement, Come at me, Bro!. The Wildywyrm does not count. The Slayer level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.
defeat one of each revenant creature in the Forinthry dungeon. Players can bring a friend along to kill the higher-levelled revenants. Optionally, players can use a Forinthry bracelet.

craft some bakriminel bolts from scratch in the Wilderness. The hatchet may be on the tool belt.

Make sure to speak to Mami Rimba, who resides near the wilderness wall north-west of Edgeville, first before attempting to chop a bloodwood tree for the first time. The bakriminel bolt tips must be bought from Mami Rimba.

Fletch the bloodwood logs into bakriminel bolt shafts near a bloodwood tree, and attach the bolt tips.

The level requirements for this achievement cannot be boosted. While bolts can be made with the Assist System or a skill boost, they do not count to complete this achievement.
make a combat potion from scratch inside Nardah.
talk to Selene (in south-eastern corner of City of Um, not the Moonclan priestess) to learn a Necromancy prayer.
upgrade the death guard, skull lantern or a piece of deathwarden robes to tier 20 following the Kili Row quest.

The view can be found at the top of the clock tower by climbing up the stairs in the house directly to the east of Lupe's shop, Soul Supplies, then crossing the wooden scaffolding and standing behind the clock face.

kill a ghostly troll thrower or ghostly troll bruiser using the Necromancy skill. Only the last hit needs to be done with a Necromancy weapon for the achievement to complete.

Ghostly trolls can be found inside of the City of Um troll cave which is entered via the large cave opening on the southern coast of the City of Um.
use the Finger of Death ability while having six stacks of Necrosis.
deposit a ritual focus object into the focus storage at the City of Um ritual site.
dispel any ritual disturbance while performing a Necromancy ritual.
complete a lesser necroplasm ritual.
have a Skeleton Warrior conjured while fighting a skeleton.
craft spirit runes at the spirit altar or bone runes at the bone altar. The spirit runes crafted during Rune Mythos do not count.
make regular ghostly ink while in the City of Um.
buy an item from Soul Supplies in the City of Um.
mix a necromancy potion (by combining an unfinished marrentill potion with cadava berries) while in the City of Um.
upgrade the death guard, skull lantern, or a piece of deathwarden robe armour to tier 50 following the Kili Row quest and Kili's Knowledge III.
craft flesh runes using the flesh altar in the Necromantic Rune Temple.
use the defensive ability Reflect while the Lesser Bone Shield incantation is active.
activate the Command Skeleton Warrior ability.
teleport to the City of Um using the City of Um Teleport incantation.
use any alteration glyph such as Multiply I in a ritual.
complete a communion ritual using a memento (such as a broken or fragile memento).
have either a Putrid Zombie or Vengeful Ghost conjured while fighting a zombie or ghost respectively.
use the Bloat ability to make an enemy apply the Bloated debuff to at least two targets on their death.

catch a ghost impling while wearing a full set of ghostly robe outfit. Keepsaked ghostly robes do not work. Boosting Hunter in order to catch the impling also does not work.

Implings are marked with yellow dots on the minimap. There is no easy way to find a ghost impling as they are very rare but hopping worlds at the Hanging Gardens and looking at the map for unusual yellow dots is one of the most efficient methods. Alternatively, implings may also be found in Lake Mnemosyne by renting a boat with Ed, if the players have level 65 Necromancy.

The impling can be caught either bare-handed or with a butterfly net and impling jar.
teleport to the Ungael ritual site using the Ungael Teleport incantation.

spin fungal bowstring at the spinning wheel next to the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um. Players are required level 82 Fletching and the level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.
plant a morchella mushroom spore in the mushroom patch in the City of Um.

rest while listening to the Dead Beats in the City of Um. The band is located in the main plaza just outside The Last Call pub. To complete the achievement, select the "Listen to" option on any band member on the bandstand.

catch a raw ghostly sole and cook it in the City of Um. For cooking the fish, players may either bring logs to start a fire, use the Bait and Switch relic power, or walk north and use the oven in the City of Um bakery east of the City of Um bank.
smelt a necronium bar at the smithy in the City of Um.
craft some miasma runes at the miasma altar.

create a passing bracelet, performing each step in the City of Um.

The player must cast the Lvl-5 Enchant spell; using a spell tablet will not count for the achievement.

The player must also have 79 Crafting and 68 Magic to complete the achievement. They cannot be boosted.
mix an overload within The Last Call in the City of Um. The overload does not need to be made from scratch; only performing the final step of adding the clean torstol will suffice.

hit an enemy with Volley of Souls with at least three Residual Soul stacks within the City of Um.

The only place to do regular combat in the city is in the City of Um troll cave, south-east of the City of Um bank, which contains ghostly troll bruisers and throwers. Alternatively, you can duel another player.

dispel six ritual disturbances within a single ritual. This can only be completed by doing any powerful ritual (although powerful lost things will require luck or the use of an imp soul in a box) or the manifest ectoplasm ritual.

The achievement can be completed at the Ungael ritual site or the Um ritual site.
give a blueberry pie to Thalmund when he appears in the City of Um every Wednesday.

activate the Sorrow prayer over the River Noumenon. The prayer is unlocked by speaking to Selene in the City of Um with level 90 Necromancy.

The River Noumenon can be returned to after Nomad's Elegy by going through Death's door behind the desk in Death's office. Players will not gain this achievement for praying over the river during the quest.

The player will need to have completed The Temple at Senntisten to have unlocked Ancient Curses, which is required to unlock the Sorrow prayer.

track eight of the owls in the City of Um.

The owls are part of the Birds of Prey achievement unlocked after the Housing of Parliament quest.

Players who have just finished Housing of Parliament may need to log out and then back in after for the owls to appear around the city for them.

craft a soul rune at the soul altar while wearing any item version of the soul cape. Boosts do not work to obtain this achievement.

Using a keepsaked version of any soul capes or the Ravensworn Cape will not complete the achievement.

speak to Mekhat within the Sanctum of Rebirth. A catspeak amulet or an equivalent must be equipped while talking to Mekhat to complete the achievement.

Mekhat is only accessible once Nakatra, Devourer Eternal has been defeated, meaning a full clear of the Sanctum of Rebirth is required to complete this achievement. If all players in the group leave the sanctum after defeating Nakatra but before a player has completed this achievement, the sanctum will reset and another full clear will be required.

If a player is carrying someone who is having trouble surviving the final fight, the other player can sit in the lower area before the boss arena while the player does the fight solo. This still allows the other player to talk to Mekhat.
claim a herald cape from the Herald of Lumbridge.
